unstop-1798652.body:
Opening introduction: 
GiveNShi Origins ~ Time of Life is an exclusive women-only experience at an eco-resort in Rishikesh, welcoming an international audience from India, the US and Europe. We’re looking for an organised, resourceful Event Lead to work with the founding team and bring its first chapter to life in February 2027.
 Key responsibilities: 
 Own event planning and execution: translate the programme into timelines, budgets, staffing requirements and practical plans for accommodation, transport, materials, vendors and on-site operations.
 Build and coordinate the organising team: identify skill gaps, help source and recruit talent, and coordinate 4–7 functional leads and their teams, with clear responsibilities and regular follow-through.
 Manage participants and guest arrangements: coordinate communication, travel and hosting for activity leaders, international guests and invited women executives, working closely with the programme leads.
 Keep delivery on track: maintain task and expense trackers, resolve operational issues, flag decisions needing founder input, and coordinate with the promotions team on outreach and registrations.
 Work arrangement: 
Paid contract from December 2026 to mid-March 2027; an earlier November start is welcome. Initially part-time, approximately 20 hours/week, combining remote work with a few coworking days per week in Delhi NCR from December. Expect a 3–7-day Rishikesh planning visit in December and longer on-site stays during January, followed by substantially increased availability from mid-January through mid-March. Approved work-related travel expenses are covered. Strong performance may lead to a full-time role and opportunities to organise future international chapters.
 Note on Compensation: 
Advertised compensation is the annualised full-time equivalent. Initial part-time compensation will be ₹15,000–20,000/month (based on 20hr/week commitment), increasing to ₹30,000–40,000/month during the full-time phase. This is a fixed-term contract through mid-March 2027, with a possibility to be converted to full-time, based on success of the event.

unstop-1807028.body:
About Sionx Innovations 
 Sionx Innovations Private Limited focuses on technology-driven solutions that support modern education and business environments, including interactive digital boards and smart display solutions.
 We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated individuals who want to gain practical experience in sales, business development, customer engagement and professional communication.
 Role Overview 
 As a Sales & Business Development Intern, you will represent Sionx Innovations in your assigned district. Your primary responsibility will be to identify potential customers, introduce the company's products and solutions, generate business leads and coordinate product demonstrations.
 You will interact with school principals, college management teams, educational institutions and business owners to understand their requirements and introduce suitable technology solutions.
 You will receive guidance and product training from the company. You are not expected to independently close high-value sales; your focus will be on developing leads, building relationships and supporting the sales process.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead Generation & Market Research 
 Identify potential schools, colleges, educational institutions and businesses in your assigned district.
 Build a database of prospective customers and decision-makers.
 Research institutions that may benefit from interactive digital boards and smart classroom solutions.
 Client Interaction & Field Sales 
 Visit schools, colleges and businesses to introduce Sionx Innovations.
 Connect with principals, administrators, management representatives and business owners.
 Explain the basic features and benefits of the company's products.
 Understand customer requirements and identify potential business opportunities.
 Product Promotion & Demonstration Coordination 
 Generate interest in interactive digital boards and related technology solutions.
 Coordinate product demonstrations with the company's sales or technical team.
 Follow up with interested customers after meetings and demonstrations.
 Relationship Building & Follow-ups 
 Maintain professional relationships with prospective customers.
 Follow up on enquiries and business leads.
 Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales opportunities.
 Reporting & Performance Tracking 
 Submit regular activity and lead-generation reports.
 Maintain a database of prospects, meetings, enquiries and follow-ups.
 Work towards mutually agreed weekly and monthly performance targets.
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Must currently reside in one of the following districts:
 Tirunelveli
 Kanyakumari
 Thoothukudi
 Madurai
 Students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate studies are eligible.
 Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
 Interest in sales, marketing, business development or entrepreneurship.
 Comfortable interacting with new people and visiting institutions.
 Basic knowledge of smartphones, computers and digital communication.
 Tamil communication skills are essential; English communication is preferred.
 Willingness to undertake local field visits.
 What You Will Gain 
 Practical experience in field sales and business development.
 Exposure to B2B sales and institutional marketing.
 Experience interacting with senior management and decision-makers.
 Product knowledge of interactive digital boards and smart technology.
 Professional communication, negotiation and networking skills.
 Understanding of lead generation, customer relationship management and sales processes.
 Opportunity to transition into a full-time role based on performance.
 Ideal Candidate 
 We are looking for someone who is confident, proactive, willing to learn and comfortable stepping outside the classroom to interact with real customers.
 You do not need prior sales experience. We value communication, initiative, consistency and the willingness to learn.
 Build your skills. Create business opportunities. Start your career with Sionx Innovations.

unstop-1806421.body:
About the Company 
 Festondemand is an event-technology platform connecting event organisers with brands and sponsors. It helps organisers validate demand and explore sponsorship opportunities before hosting events. In this remote internship, you will help grow the platform’s network across India through outreach, onboarding, and partnership development.
 Responsibilities 
 Identify and onboard event organisers and event agencies across India.
 Find brands and sponsors interested in event partnerships, and connect them with relevant organisers.
 Manage outreach and follow-ups, maintain acquisition records, and ensure every acquisition is verified in Festondemand’s tracking system.
 Work toward onboarding 75 event organisers and 75 sponsors or brands, for a target of 150 total verified acquisitions.
 Requirements 
 No specific degree, course, or academic qualification is required.
 Good communication and relationship-management skills, with an interest in sales and business development.
 Proficiency and confidence in cold calling and cold direct messaging (DMing), along with networking and negotiation.
 Self-driven, target-oriented, and motivated to work independently in a remote setting.
 Duration: 3 months. This is a performance-based internship with no fixed stipend. For ticket sales, the commission is 20% of Festondemand’s 10% platform earnings from organisers you onboard. For sponsorships, the commission is 10% of the total sponsorship amount you bring in. Commissions are paid monthly on successfully realised transactions, subject to applicable targets. The role offers hands-on experience in sales, partnerships, and the event-tech startup ecosystem, along with performance-based earning opportunities. Upon completion, interns receive a certificate of internship, a letter of experience, and a letter of recommendation. Strong performers may be considered for extended engagements.

UDGAM'27 Campus Ambassador Program 
 Welcome to the UDGAM'27 Campus Ambassador Program, where passion meets opportunity! E-Cell, IIT Guwahati, invites dynamic, enthusiastic, and motivated students to become a part of our journey as we bring UDGAM'27 to life.
 As a Campus Ambassador, you will play a key role in spreading awareness about UDGAM'27, promoting its events and initiatives, and building excitement among students across your college campus.
 E-Cell, IIT Guwahati, is dedicated to promoting entrepreneurship and nurturing innovation among young minds. Through UDGAM, our annual entrepreneurship summit, we aim to bring together aspiring entrepreneurs, innovators, industry leaders, and students to create meaningful opportunities and experiences.
 The UDGAM'27 Campus Ambassador Program is an internship initiative designed to develop entrepreneurial mindsets, leadership abilities, and professional skills among students. As a bridge between E-Cell, IIT Guwahati, and your college, you will get the opportunity to explore the startup ecosystem, enhance your communication and marketing skills, build valuable connections, and contribute to one of the region's biggest entrepreneurship summits.
 Perks 
 Access to 100+ exclusive internship opportunities from various startups.
 Incentives worth INR 1 lakh+ for top performers.
 Workshops on career development, entrepreneurship, marketing, and other fields.
 Verifiable certificates upon successful completion.
 Letter of Recommendation for top-performing Campus Ambassadors.
 Top performers will get Exclusive goodies such as T-shirts, badges, and more.
 Top performers will be featured on the social media platforms of E-Cell, IIT Guwahati.
 Free UDGAM'27 passes for top-performing Campus Ambassadors.
 Responsibilities 
 Act as the primary point of contact between E-Cell, IIT Guwahati, and your college community.
 Promote UDGAM'27 and its events, competitions, and initiatives across your respective college.
 Create awareness through social media platforms, college groups, and other communication channels.
 Encourage student participation and drive registrations for UDGAM'27 events.
 Identify and connect with students interested in entrepreneurship, innovation, and startups.
 Timeline of the Internship 
 November 4th, 2026: Registrations Open
 November 18th, 2026: Registrations Close
 November 21st, 2026: Program Commencement
 January 25th, 2027: Program Conclusion
 Internship Structure & Performance Evaluation
 The UDGAM'27 Campus Ambassador Internship is designed to provide hands-on experience, practical learning, and professional development throughout the program.
 Task-Based Internship: Throughout the internship, Campus Ambassadors will be assigned various tasks and activities designed to develop their leadership, communication, management, and entrepreneurial skills.
 Performance Evaluation: Participants will be evaluated and graded based on their performance, consistency, initiative, and successful completion of assigned tasks.
 Final CV-Ready Project: At the end of the internship, participants will complete a practical project demonstrating the skills, knowledge, and experience gained throughout the program. The project will be verified by E-Cell, IIT Guwahati, allowing participants to showcase it on their CVs and professional profiles.
 Top Performer Selection: Final rankings will be determined based on the cumulative performance of participants across their assigned tasks and final project. The highest-performing Campus Ambassadors will be recognized and eligible for exclusive rewards and opportunities.
 Important Information for Applicants
 All registered participants will receive detailed information regarding the internship through their registered email addresses. This will include the assigned tasks, project guidelines, evaluation criteria, submission procedures, important deadlines, and other relevant instructions.
 Participants are advised to regularly check their registered email addresses to stay updated on internship activities, announcements, and further communication from the organizing team at E-Cell, IIT Guwahati.

amazon-10592101.body:
Network Operations Center (NOC) – Overview
The Network Operations Center (NOC) serves as the central command and control hub for Transportation Execution across Amazon's Supply Chain network, spanning multiple geographies including North America, India, and the EU.
NOC is responsible for ensuring the seamless, on-time movement of freight — from vendor pick-ups to Amazon Fulfillment Centers (FCs), and from FCs to carrier hubs. When exceptions arise, NOC takes swift ownership of resolution while keeping all relevant stakeholders informed throughout the process.
Beyond tactical problem-solving, NOC is also entrusted with a strategic mandate: identifying trends in network exceptions, driving process automation, and recommending operational improvements to streamline transportation workflows. This requires continuous network monitoring and in-depth analysis of network data.
In essence, NOC plays a pivotal role in the smooth functioning of Amazon's transportation network — directly influencing Amazon's ability to deliver on its promise to customers.
Role of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC acts as a critical link between key stakeholders — including Transportation Carriers, Hubs, and Warehouses — facilitating the flow of information and resolving issues that could impact customer experience or business continuity. The role spans two core verticals:
Inbound Operations – Manages the Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring freight is picked up on time and delivered to FCs as per scheduled appointments. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues arising during the pick-up to delivery lifecycle.
Outbound Operations – Manages the FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring trucks depart FCs on schedule to fulfill customer delivery promises. The Trans Ops Representative addresses any issues from the point freight leaves the FC through to last-mile delivery.
Trans Ops Representatives drive real-time resolutions by leveraging internal tools, querying relevant data, and making informed, time-sensitive decisions. The ideal candidate brings a solid understanding of logistics operations, a sharp eye for data trends, and the ability to communicate effectively — both verbally and in writing.
Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representatives are expected to proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and drive them to completion. Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Serving as the communication bridge between external stakeholders (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal stakeholders (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
Systematically escalating issues or data variances to the appropriate owners and teams, and following through to ensure timely resolution
Preparing and presenting weekly narratives that outline key findings and variances against goals in review forums
Delivering real-time customer experience support within a 24×7 operating environment
- Bachelor's degree in any discipline
- 12–24 months of relevant work experience
- Strong communication skills — both verbal and written — with the ability to facilitate seamless information flow between external and internal stakeholders
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and VLOOKUPs
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
- Bachelor's degree with strong academic foundation
- Sound logical and analytical thinking skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple cross-functional teams

unstop-1808727.body:
About The Business:
 Reliance Bioenergy is part of Reliance Industries' New Energy business, focused on developing sustainable energy solutions through the conversion of agricultural residue and organic waste into Compressed Biogas (CBG) and high-quality organic manure. The business aims to contribute to India's clean energy transition while creating value across the agricultural and energy value chains.
 CTC - 7.5 LPA (On Joining)
 The scale of the opportunity: 
 As part of its Phase 1 expansion, Reliance is developing 55 CBG plants across India , establishing a distributed network spanning multiple states and diverse operating environments.
 The platform already engages with 80,000+ farmers , enabling the conversion of agricultural and organic waste into valuable resources while supporting a circular economy and sustainable agricultural practices.
 Further strengthening its technological capabilities, Reliance has established its Bioenergy Technology & R&D Centre at Jamnagar , focusing on advanced enzymes, microbial consortia, high-yield energy crops, automation and improvements in bioenergy productivity.
 With significant investments in infrastructure, technology and operational capabilities, Reliance Bioenergy is building a scalable platform to advance India's renewable energy ecosystem.
 Click here to learn more about Reliance Bioenergy.
 Eligibility Criteria: 
 Full-time Engineering from AICTE-Approved Colleges: Pursued full-time BE/BTech from AICTE-Approved colleges in Agriculture Engineering or related domains only
 Graduation Year: Candidates graduated in 2025 or 2026 are eligible to apply
 Minimum CGPA / Percentage: Minimum 60% or 6 CGPA across 10th, 12th, Diploma (if applicable) and a minimum aggregate of 60% or more in the B. Tech. Agriculture domain.
 No Active Backlogs and No Cases of Detention: Students who currently have active backlogs or have experienced academic detention are not eligible.

unstop-1807992.body:
Position Overview 
 Position: Process Executive – International Voice Process 
 Client: Leading IT MNC 
 Process: Inbound Customer Service 
 Job Type: Full-Time 
 Work Location: Kolkata & Indore 
 Work Mode: Work from Office (Initial requirement; remote work may be evaluated later) 
 Working Days: 5 Days a Week 
 Compensation & Benefits 
 Annual CTC: 
 Freshers: 2.6 LPA 
 Experienced Candidates (up to 11 months): 2.9 LPA 
 Shift Allowances: Night Shift Allowance provided 
 Transportation: Cab/Transport facility available for night shifts 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Handle inbound calls from international customers politely and professionally. 
 Process customer orders over the phone. 
 Answer questions and resolve issues related to orders and deliveries. 
 Accurately log customer details and call interaction notes into the system. 
 Maintain key performance metrics: Productivity , Call Quality , Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) , and Service-Level Targets . 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Education: Non-Technical Graduation Streams (e.g., BA, B.Com, B.Sc, BBA). 
 Eligible Batches: 2024, 2025, and 2026 graduates are eligible. 
 Marks/CGPA Criteria: None. 
 Backlogs/Arrears: Strictly No active backlogs . 
 Experience: 0 to 11 months only (Freshers welcome). 
 Age Limit: Minimum 18 years old (No upper age limit). 
 Language Proficiency: Strong English communication skills 
 Shift Flexibility: Must be comfortable working in permanent rotational night shifts within the shift window of 9:30 PM to 11:30 AM . 
 Required Skills & Attributes 
 Excellent spoken English communication. 
 Customer-centric attitude and active listening skills. 
 Ability to multi-task and handle call volumes effectively. 
 Ability to remain calm, patient, and professional under pressure. 
 Willingness to learn new tools, processes, and systems. 
 Selection, Training & Onboarding Process 
 Initial Screening / Preliminary Rounds: 
 2 Rounds of Communication Interviews. 
 Training Program: 
 Duration: Minimum 1 Month (25 to 30 days) of specialized International Voice Process training conducted at Arich. 
 Assessments: Periodic evaluations conducted during training. 
 Final Selection & Evaluation: 
 Voice & Accent (V&A) Assessment: Human-based round focusing on communication skills and customer-centric knowledge. 
 Final Round: 1 interview round with the Client Operations team. 
 Offer & Onboarding: 
 Candidate submits required documentation (Education credentials, Previous Employment details if applicable, ID & Address Proof). 
 Background Verification (BGV) process initiated. 
 Offer letter issued upon document verification. 
 Joining timeline: Within 1 week to 10 days post-selection. 
 Service Agreement/Bond: None . 
 Standard probation period applies.

Title – Retail Sales Associate  
 Reporting to – Store Manager  
 Skip Level – Area Operations Manager  
 About Lenskart   
 With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers’ eye powers. Backed by IDG  Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.  
 About the Role  
 Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.  
 Responsibilities: 
 Customer Focus 
 Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
 He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
 He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
 He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has.
 Product Recommendation 
 With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
 He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
 Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence 
 Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently.
 Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse.
 He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer.
 In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
 Store upkeep & maintenance 
 He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly.
 He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.
 Personal attributes & Competencies 
 Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
 Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
 Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
 Clear articulation and active listening skills
 Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
 Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
 Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

unstop-1808526.body:
About Ethos Education 
 Ethos Education is a global education consulting and mentorship organisation that helps students explore opportunities at leading universities worldwide, including Ivy League and other top global institutions.
 We work with experienced mentors and university graduates to guide students through university applications, profile building, career exploration, scholarships, essays, interviews and the overall admissions process.
 Overview 
 We are looking for enthusiastic, proactive and well-connected students to join us as International Education Ambassadors .
 As an ambassador, you will represent Ethos within your college, school, peer groups and wider student communities. You will help create awareness about international education opportunities and connect students who may benefit from expert guidance and mentorship.
 This fellowship is an opportunity to develop your communication, networking, leadership and outreach skills while gaining exposure to the global education landscape.
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 Create awareness about international education, global universities and study-abroad opportunities among students.
 Connect with friends, classmates, juniors, seniors and other student networks who may be interested in overseas education.
 Introduce students and parents to Ethos's mentorship and university admissions services.
 Build connections with teachers, tutors, student clubs, college societies and educational communities.
 Share relevant information, campaigns and opportunities through personal networks and social media.
 Identify interested students and connect them with the Ethos team for further guidance.
 Participate in outreach initiatives and maintain basic records of referrals and interactions.
 Who Can Apply? 
 School and college students with good communication and interpersonal skills.
 Students who are active in their academic institutions, clubs, societies or student communities.
 Individuals who enjoy networking, connecting with people and taking initiative.
 Students interested in international education, global universities, leadership and community building.
 Prior experience in marketing, outreach or student ambassador programmes is an advantage, but not mandatory.
 What You Will Gain 
 Official International Education Ambassador recognition with Ethos Education.
 Certificate of Fellowship upon successful completion, subject to programme requirements.
 Performance-based incentives for successful student referrals.
 Practical exposure to outreach, networking, communication and partnership building.
 Opportunity to interact with the Ethos team and learn about global university admissions.
 Experience in representing an international education organisation and building your professional network.
 Compensation: Monthly fixed stipend (subject to performance and programme requirements) + additional performance-based incentives for successful student referrals.
 Future Opportunities 
 This fellowship can serve as a pathway to a potential full-time opportunity with Ethos Education. Pre-final year students are especially encouraged to apply, as exceptional performers may have the opportunity to explore a full-time role with us upon graduation, based on their performance, contribution and organisational requirements.
 How to Apply 
 If you are someone who enjoys connecting with people, taking initiative and creating opportunities within your community, we would love to hear from you.
 Apply now and become a part of the Ethos Education Ambassador community!

unstop-1808095.body:
About the Role: 
 Join our security operations team and learn the day-to-day work of a SOC on a live environment. A working security engineer will review your work and teach you how we investigate and decide.
 What You'll Do: 
 Monitor and triage alerts in our SIEM (Wazuh): separate false positives from real threats and write up what you found. 
 Investigate web attacks, scans and brute-force attempts using nginx, authentication and system logs, and enrich IPs, domains and file hashes with threat-intelligence tools. 
 Review vulnerability scan results across Linux servers, help prioritise fixes, track patching of newly published critical advisories and verify the fixes. 
 Tune detection rules and decoders, test them, and cut down alert noise. 
 Support file integrity monitoring, configuration checks against CIS benchmarks, and onboarding of new servers into monitoring. 
 Build and maintain security dashboards and weekly reports for the team. 
 Write short runbooks and incident write-ups. 
 Automate repetitive checks with Python or Bash, and help test AI-assisted alert triage. 
 Tools and Topics: 
 Wazuh and OpenSearch dashboards, Linux (Debian/Ubuntu), Docker, cloud security basics (GCP), CI/CD tooling, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE/NVD, web server logs, OWASP Top 10.
 Eligibility: 
 B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity or a related field (BCA/MCA also welcome). 
 Graduates only. Final-year students are not eligible. 
 Solid basics of networking (TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS) and the Linux command line. 
 Understanding of common attacks (brute force, SQL injection, malware, phishing). 
 Ability to read logs and explain your findings in clear written English. 
 Curiosity and care: you check before you conclude. 
 Able to work from our Noida office five days a week. 
 Good to Have: 
 Hands-on lab work with Wazuh, Splunk, ELK or QRadar. 
 TryHackMe or Hack The Box activity, CTFs or a home lab. 
 Basic Python or Bash. 
 Entry-level certifications or courses, such as the Google Cybersecurity Certificate, Fortinet NSE 1-2, Cisco's introductory cybersecurity courses or Microsoft SC-900. 
 What You'll Gain: 
 Hands-on SOC experience on production systems, not a simulation. 
 Mentoring from a working security engineer. 
 Internship completion certificate. 
 Conversion to a full-time role based on your performance.

unstop-1808707.body:
A little about us: 
 We're GuruCool, an early-stage technology startup building a connected operating system for educational institutions.
 We're working on a simple but meaningful problem: teachers spend too much time on administrative work, students often become messengers between institutions and parents, and important information doesn't always reach the right people when it should.
 We believe thoughtful technology can change that.
 Our goal is to bring academics, attendance, communication, administration, and everyday institutional operations into one connected ecosystem.
 And we're looking for a few curious minds who would like to be part of building it.
 What will you actually do? 
 You'll work with our team on real projects, explore how technology products are built, and learn by solving actual problems.
 Depending on your interests and abilities, you may contribute to:
 Product development, research, and feature planning.
 Software development, testing, and debugging.
 AI, automation, and exploring new technologies.
 UI/UX improvements and understanding user problems.
 Documentation, problem-solving, and improving existing workflows.
 You won't just be watching tutorials or working on imaginary assignments. We want you to understand the reasoning behind what we're building and contribute wherever you can.
 Here's what we expect from you: 
 We don't expect you to know everything. Seriously. 
 You might not know a particular programming language, tool, framework, or development process, and that's okay.
 What matters more to us is how you think, how you approach unfamiliar problems, and what you do when you don't know the answer.
 We appreciate people who ask questions, experiment, make mistakes, accept feedback, and genuinely try to improve.

amazon-10604975.body:
Amazon's IT Logistics and Imaging Team (ITS-LIT) operates a warehouse-scale production floor that images, provisions, and manages the lifecycle of every corporate laptop and device deployed to Amazonian across regions. Our team at HYD24 IT Hub making sure Day1 new hire on-boarding with shipping laptop, Manage the Lifecycle of laptop, inventory management, reverse logistics, process ITAD.
Amazon's IT Services (ITS) team is seeking a Data Center Material Associate to join our HYD24 IT Hub and support daily operational activities. In this role, you will be responsible for asset picking and packing based on demand, coordinating asset movement and shipping, overseeing the full asset lifecycle, and handling the e-waste disposal of laptops. You will be expected to independently manage your workload, prioritize effectively across competing demands, and ensure accuracy and quality in every transaction.
Serving as the central coordination point between internal stakeholders, logistics partners, and asset-management systems, you will drive timely asset returns and help maintain our Day-1 delivery SLA targets. This position combines operational execution, data accuracy, and strong communication, all carried out within established policies and standard operating procedures.
Key job responsibilities
Asset Picking & Packing: Pick and pack IT assets based on daily demand, ensuring accuracy and dispatch readiness.
Dock Operations: Manage inbound and outbound dock activities, including receiving, staging, and dispatching shipments.
Asset Movement & Shipping: Coordinate timely movement and shipping, tracking each transaction to destination.
Asset Validation: Verify asset details against system records to confirm serial numbers, configurations, and quantities.
Laptop Imaging: Image laptops to configure devices to required standards and ensure deployment readiness.
Break-Fix Management: Identify faulty assets, coordinate repairs or replacements, and restore devices with minimal downtime.
E-Waste Handling: Manage safe, compliant disposal of laptop e-waste per environmental and data-security standards.
Vendor & Customer Coordination: Act as the primary contact for vendors, logistics partners, and customers to align shipment schedules and resolve queries.
Asset Lifecycle Management: Oversee the full asset lifecycle, from inbound receipt through deployment, returns, and disposition.
SLA & Day-1 Delivery: Drive timely asset returns and consistently meet Day-1 delivery SLA targets.
Data Accuracy & Quality: Maintain precise records across asset-management systems, ensuring quality in every transaction while working independently within established policies and procedures.
A day in the life
Your day starts at the HYD24 IT Hub, reviewing demand and prioritizing across competing deadlines. At the dock, you receive, stage, and validate inbound assets against system records. You pick and pack assets, image laptops to required standards, and work through break-fix requests to restore devices with minimal downtime. Throughout the day, you coordinate with vendors, logistics partners, and customers to align shipments and meet Day-1 delivery SLA targets. You keep asset records accurate, handle laptop e-waste responsibly, and manage your workload independently serving as the central coordination point that keeps assets moving and stakeholders aligned.
About the team
Logistics and Imaging team (LIT) is the operational under Amazon's IT Services (ITS) at the HYD24 IT Hub. We keep IT assets moving ensuring the right devices reach the right people, fully configured and on time. Our work spans the full asset journey: receiving and validating inbound shipments, imaging laptops to Amazon's standards, picking and packing against daily demand, and coordinating outbound shipments. We manage the complete asset lifecycle, handle e-waste responsibly, and partner with vendors and logistics providers to meet Day-1 delivery SLA targets. We value ownership, collaboration, and accuracy in every transaction.

- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager
- Undergraduate degree
- 1+ years of shipping & receiving, inventory and warehousing practices experience
- Experience in logistics, or experience in courier industry

amazon-10604014.body:
NOC (Network Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting India. It ensures timely tracking procurement and movement between various Amazon hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 
1. Watch CCTV camera recordings from Amazon operations sites and check whether the activities on video follow the correct process, by answering a set of defined audit questions for each site.
2. Use the camera viewing software to find and open the right camera for a given location and time, and look closely at the footage to spot any process gaps or incorrect handling.
3. Complete the number of audits assigned for your shift each day, keeping both speed and accuracy at the expected level.
4. Build familiarity with how each site is laid out, how packages move through it, and how the cameras are named and positioned, so that you can quickly locate the correct footage to review.
5. Record your findings in the audit system, take screenshots as proof wherever a process is not being followed, and save that proof in the right place within the required time.
6. Follow the step by step checks defined for each audit question, and raise anything unclear or unusual to your team lead or manager.
7. Share your audit results on the schedule set for each audit type, whether that is daily, weekly, or once in two weeks.
8. Treat all video footage and findings as confidential, and follow the rules on data privacy and camera access at all times.
9. Take part in the training and practice when you join, including watching experienced auditors at work and then being observed yourself, and learn to handle more than one type of audit.
10. Meet the quality standards set for audit accuracy, and take part in the review sessions that check and improve the quality of audits.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel.
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network.
- Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as access control/intrusion detection and CCTV surveillance systems
- Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities

MindMach Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is hiring for a Business Development Executive! 
 About the Company: 
 MindMach Technologies Pvt. Ltd. works in the hiring and staffing industry, connecting businesses with talent and supporting their recruitment needs. The Business Development Executive will help build the company’s B2B pipeline by engaging prospective clients and creating qualified opportunities for the sales team.
 Responsibilities :
 Make outbound cold calls to prospective business clients and introduce the company’s hiring and staffing services.
 Identify and connect with HR and Talent Acquisition leaders to understand their recruitment needs.
 Ask relevant questions, qualify prospects, and maintain clear records of conversations and follow-up actions.
 Schedule meetings between qualified prospects and the sales team, ensuring useful context is shared ahead of each discussion.
 Work proactively toward outreach and meeting targets while communicating professionally with prospective clients.
 Requirements :
 Strong verbal communication skills and confidence speaking with business stakeholders over the phone.
 A proactive, target-oriented approach and willingness to learn B2B sales and lead generation.
 Ability to listen carefully, understand client requirements, and qualify potential opportunities.
 Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome to apply.
 This is a full-time remote role with a monthly salary range of ₹20,000–₹40,000.

 Make and receive calls to share relevant banking-related information and respond to customer queries.
 Understand customer needs, communicate available information clearly, and direct complex questions to the appropriate team.
 Maintain accurate records of calls, follow-ups, and customer interactions.
 Conduct follow-ups professionally and contribute to a positive customer experience while working remotely.
 Requirements :
 Strong verbal communication, listening, and interpersonal skills.
 Comfort using a phone and maintaining clear records of conversations and follow-ups.
 Ability to learn role-specific processes and communicate responsibly in a banking-sector environment.
 Prior experience requirements were not specified; candidates will be assessed based on interview performance and relevant skills.

unstop-1810278.body:
About NDMIT 
 NDMIT is a career-focused training institute dedicated to providing practical, industry-oriented education in Data Science, Digital Marketing, and emerging technologies . We are looking for a passionate Data Science Trainer who can train, mentor, and guide students toward successful careers in Data Science and Analytics. 
 Qualification 
 Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering , or a related field. 
 Candidates with relevant industry experience and strong practical knowledge are encouraged to apply. 
 Key Skills Required 
 Python – Data handling, Pandas, NumPy, data visualization, etc. 
 SQL – Queries, joins, subqueries, aggregations, database concepts. 
 Excel – Functions, Pivot Tables, dashboards, data analysis. 
 Power BI – Data modeling, DAX, dashboards, and visualization. 
 Statistics – Descriptive statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression, etc. 
 Machine Learning – Supervised & unsupervised learning, model building, evaluation, and practical implementation. 
 Generative AI – ChatGPT, Prompt Engineering, AI tools, and practical AI applications. 
 Strong communication, presentation, and classroom management skills . 
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 Deliver engaging and interactive Data Science training sessions for students. 
 Explain technical concepts in a simple, practical, and easy-to-understand manner . 
 Conduct hands-on exercises, assignments, case studies, and real-world projects . 
 Train students on Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Generative AI. 
 Design and update course content, presentations, assignments, quizzes, and assessments . 
 Guide students in developing industry-relevant Data Science and Analytics projects . 
 Mentor students and help them understand real-world applications of Data Science. 
 Conduct doubt-solving sessions and provide regular feedback on student performance. 
 Prepare students for Data Analyst/Data Scientist interviews and job opportunities . 
 Stay updated with the latest developments in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Generative AI . 
 Collaborate with the academic and placement teams to improve students' learning and career outcomes. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 1–3 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Training, or a related domain . 
 Strong practical knowledge of the required technologies. 
 Prior teaching/training experience will be an advantage. 
 Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to beginners. 
 Good presentation and interpersonal skills. 
 Passionate about teaching, mentoring, and helping students build careers. 
 Candidates who have worked on real-world Data Science/Analytics projects will be preferred.

Location: Gurgaon (Hybrid)

 About Us 
 Coy is a dating platform that helps people find out if someone they like likes them back. The idea is simple: add someone you secretly have a crush on. If they add you back, it's a match. If they don't, nobody ever finds out.
 We believe Coy has the potential to make an interesting place for itself in the consumer internet space by combining curiosity, relationships, and a simple product experience.
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our core technology team and help build and scale Coy. You will work directly with the founding team, take ownership of product features and solve real engineering challenges.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Build responsive web applications using React.js / Next.js.
 Develop scalable backend APIs using Node.js / Express.js.
 Build product features around onboarding, contact matching and mutual-match journeys.
 Integrate third-party services such as SMS, WhatsApp, email and payment gateways.
 Optimise application performance, security and scalability.
 Requirements 
 Strong fundamentals in JavaScript and full-stack development.
 Experience with React.js, Next.js, Node.js and Express.js.
 Familiarity with SQL / NoSQL databases and REST APIs.
 Understanding of Git, GitHub and basic DevOps workflows.
 A builder mindset with experience in side projects, hackathons or products you've independently shipped.
 Why You Should Join Us 
 Build a consumer internet product from an early stage.
 Work directly with the founding team and influence technology decisions.
 Take ownership of critical product features and see your work impact real users.

 Narayana Group of Institutions operates in the education sector and is seeking a Business Development Executive for its Faridabad team.  Ability to work full-time in an in-office role based in Faridabad.

unstop-1811418.body:
About NDMIT 
 NDMIT is a career-focused training institute dedicated to providing practical, industry-oriented education in Data Science, Digital Marketing, and emerging technologies . We are looking for a passionate Data Science Trainer who can train, mentor, and guide students toward successful careers in Data Science and Analytics.
 Qualification 
 Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering , or a related field.
 Candidates with relevant industry experience and strong practical knowledge are encouraged to apply.
 Key Skills Required 
 Python – Data handling, Pandas, NumPy, data visualization, etc.
 SQL – Queries, joins, subqueries, aggregations, database concepts.
 Excel – Functions, Pivot Tables, dashboards, data analysis.
 Power BI – Data modeling, DAX, dashboards, and visualization.
 Statistics – Descriptive statistics, probability, hypothesis testing, correlation, regression, etc.
 Machine Learning – Supervised & unsupervised learning, model building, evaluation, and practical implementation.
 Generative AI – ChatGPT, Prompt Engineering, AI tools, and practical AI applications.
 Strong communication, presentation, and classroom management skills .
 Roles & Responsibilities 
 Deliver engaging and interactive Data Science training sessions for students.
 Explain technical concepts in a simple, practical, and easy-to-understand manner .
 Conduct hands-on exercises, assignments, case studies, and real-world projects .
 Train students on Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Statistics, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
 Design and update course content, presentations, assignments, quizzes, and assessments .
 Guide students in developing industry-relevant Data Science and Analytics projects .
 Mentor students and help them understand real-world applications of Data Science.
 Conduct doubt-solving sessions and provide regular feedback on student performance.
 Prepare students for Data Analyst/Data Scientist interviews and job opportunities .
 Stay updated with the latest developments in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Generative AI .
 Collaborate with the academic and placement teams to improve students' learning and career outcomes.
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 1–3 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Training, or a related domain .
 Strong practical knowledge of the required technologies.
 Prior teaching/training experience will be an advantage.
 Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to beginners.
 Good presentation and interpersonal skills.
 Passionate about teaching, mentoring, and helping students build careers.
 Candidates who have worked on real-world Data Science/Analytics projects will be preferred.

About us: 
 PPS Anantams Corporation Pvt Ltd (Samanvay Westbreeze, Gotri, Vadodara) runs three businesses under one roof, all automated in-house with AI. Our founder has 25+ years in petroleum downstream and has commissioned 10 bitumen plants.
 PPS Anantams - Bitumen & Roads: supply and trading of bitumen and bitumen products (VG-10/30/40, emulsion, CRMB/PMB; bulk and drum) for road projects across India.
 YUGA PMC - Plant Consulting (yuga-pmc.in): project management for plastic and tyre pyrolysis, bio-bitumen, PMB/CRMB, bitumen emulsion, blown bitumen and decanter plants, from feasibility to commissioning: DPR, licences, machinery and OEM selection, training, funding and carbon-credit support.
 PACPL - Algo & Indicators (pacplindicators.com): TradingView Pine Script indicators and strategies, MT4/MT5 Expert Advisors, Telegram alert bots, broker-API algos and Python dashboards built to each client's own rules. Software and education only; no tips or advice.
 What you will do: 
 Lead management: Facebook and Instagram lead forms, WhatsApp and Telegram chatbots and auto-chat, lead sheets and CRM, follow-ups and retargeting of interested leads.
 Branding: daily posts, image cards and short videos for each business on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, Threads, YouTube and WhatsApp.
 Delivery with AI: AI-assisted Pine Script and Python coding, backtest reports and client updates (PACPL); DPR drafts, plant drawing and layout support, OEM/RFQ and client emails (YUGA PMC); buyer-seller data, rate updates and market reports (bitumen).
 Workflows: n8n or Make, Google Apps Script, WhatsApp Cloud API and Meta Business Suite, linking Google Sheets, Gmail and Drive.
 Systems: manage company software, AI tools, accounts and office hardware, and document every automation so it keeps running.
 Our AI stack: 
 Claude (Anthropic) is the AI we use across the business, including Claude Code for software work. Every automation tool we use connects to Claude.
 Who can apply: 
 Final-semester B.E./B.Tech (CSE, IT, AI & ML), BCA or MCA students with no exams left, or 2024-2026 graduates.
 Hands-on with AI tools, prompt writing, and basic Python or no-code automation.
 Lives in Vadodara; full-time at our Gotri office, 9 AM to 6 PM (2nd and 4th Saturday half day).
 Stipend and perks: 
 Rs 8,000 a month fixed, plus up to Rs 3,000 monthly incentive for automations delivered and running. Certificate and letter of recommendation. Strong performers will be considered for a full-time role.
 Selection process: 
 Screening questions.
 A 48-hour practical AI task: build a working automation that takes a new lead from a Google Form, writes a personalised WhatsApp or email reply with AI, and logs it in a Google Sheet. Share a 3-minute screen recording and a one-page note.
 Interview at our Gotri office with a live demo of your task.
 There is no fee at any stage.

This unpaid, remote internship offers a chance to contribute to an early-stage product in the foundational AI model landscape.

 At least six months of relevant experience; an entrepreneurial mindset and interest in foundational AI systems are valued.
 MBA or BBA qualification, familiarity with AI, and an interest in investor relations. Candidates from engineering backgrounds should not apply.
 Strong communication and relationship-building abilities, along with meeting-coordination skills for engaging business owners across industries.
 Ability to commit to learning and gaining experience for at least six months. This is an unpaid, work-from-home internship with full-time hours.

unstop-1813471.body:
Executive – Digital Marketing | Mevive International 
 Job Details 
 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Reporting To: Marketing Manager/Head
 Experience: 0–2 Years
 Languages Required: Fluent English and any one of Tamil, Hindi, or Malayalam
 Education: Bachelor's/Master's degree or PGDM in Digital Marketing, Marketing, Mass Communication, or a related field
 Why This Role Exists 
 Mevive International needs a consistent and visible presence across digital channels to attract buyers and sellers and build brand trust, especially ahead of its launch.
 This role will manage day-to-day digital marketing execution, including content, campaigns, SEO/PPC, and analytics, ensuring the brand maintains a consistent presence across relevant platforms and that performance is tracked effectively.
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Plan, schedule, and execute social media content calendars across LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.
 Write compelling, platform-specific copy for blogs, social media posts, and digital advertisements.
 Run and optimise paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, alongside SEO, to drive organic traffic.
 Track performance using Google Analytics and other web analytics tools, and report on key metrics and conversions.
 Create and adjust visual assets using Canva or Adobe tools for quick-turnaround content.
 Manage email marketing campaigns and day-to-day social media community engagement.
 Stay updated on algorithm changes, digital trends, and emerging AI tools to keep strategies effective.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with the sales team to align marketing efforts with business goals.
 What We're Looking For 
 Bachelor's/Master's degree or PGDM in Digital Marketing, Marketing, Mass Communication, or a related field.
 0–2 years of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, or a related role.
 Proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and SEO tools.
 Working knowledge of basic HTML/CSS and conversion tracking.
 Strong copywriting skills and familiarity with design tools such as Canva or Adobe Photoshop/Express.
 Fluency in English is mandatory, along with proficiency in any one of Tamil, Hindi, or Malayalam.
 Adaptability, organisational skills, and the ability to collaborate across teams.

unstop-1813165.body:
About the Company 
 NAADI is a technology-driven company focused on digitalising the home interiors industry. We develop ERP solutions for modular furniture manufacturing and innovative design tools that simplify the design-to-manufacturing process. 
 Our Design Tool, launched in 2025, enables users to create 3D designs, generate realistic renderings, prepare 2D detailing and streamline manufacturing workflows. 
 Job Overview 
 We are looking for enthusiastic and detail-oriented Design Engineers with a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering to join our team. The candidate will work on developing and improving parametric design modules for our design platform. 
 This opportunity is suitable for fresh graduates who are interested in 3D design, product development, parametric modelling and design technology. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Understand product requirements and existing parametric product structures. 
 Develop and configure parametric design modules using Coohom. 
 Collaborate with front-end 3D designers to improve design modules. 
 Refine and enhance existing modules based on product requirements. 
 Contribute to expanding and maintaining the product module library. 
 Coordinate with Product Managers and Implementation Engineers to ensure smooth execution. 
 Research emerging trends in parametric design, 3D visualisation, VR and manufacturing technologies. 
 Identify design issues and support troubleshooting and improvements. 
 Required Skills 
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
 Basic understanding of mechanical design concepts. 
 Interest in 3D modelling, product design and parametric design. 
 Good analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Ability to understand technical requirements and learn new tools. 
 Good communication and coordination skills. 
 Willingness to work collaboratively in a team environment. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience with design tools or 3D modelling software. 
 Basic knowledge of CAD tools or parametric modelling. 
 Exposure to Coohom or similar design platforms will be an added advantage. 
 Eligibility 
 Freshers with 0 years of experience can apply. 
 Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. 
 Candidates should be willing to work from the Bengaluru office. 
 What We Offer 
 Opportunity to work with innovative design technology. 
 Hands-on exposure to parametric design and 3D visualisation. 
 Learning and professional development opportunities. 
 Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment. 
 Salary: Up to ₹30,000 per month, depending on skills and interview performance.

unstop-1785860.body:
About the Company
 Unstop derived from the belief to #BeUnstoppable , is a community engagement and hiring platform for students and freshers where talent meets opportunities.
 It is a playground for this talent to learn, upskill, showcase their skills, gain CV points and get hired while unlocking their true potential throughout their academic journey. This enables them to eventually get hired by their dream employers and start their career journey. The platform connects students across domains in INDIA to a world of opportunities across the GLOBE. Unstop currently has a community of 32 million+ Students and Freshers.
 Major brands such as Amazon, Flipkart, HUL, Reliance, Tata, Mahindra, Uber, Accenture, Infosys, EY, PwC, and many others entrust Unstop with their early talent recruitment needs. These companies interact with students and early professionals via Unstop's tech platform and leverage expertise to build their dream teams.
 Responsibilities
 Own product strategy, roadmap planning, and execution for key platform initiatives.
 Translate customer, business, and market insights into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
 Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, operations, and leadership teams to deliver high-quality experiences.
 Define priorities, manage trade-offs, and guide products from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.
 Track adoption, engagement, and business metrics to identify opportunities and improve product performance.
 Requirements
 At least 5 years of experience in product management in a relevant industry or a closely related role.
 Strong understanding of product discovery, prioritization, experimentation, and lifecycle management.
 Excellent communication, analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and problem-solving abilities.
 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and take ownership of outcomes.
 Experience building user-focused digital products is preferred.

About Us

 We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Customer Success Manager to ensure exceptional service delivery to our clients. As the Customer Success Manager, you will be responsible for managing client accounts, resolving inquiries through chat, liaising with product and service providers, and building scalable processes for future customer support team members. This role requires strong leadership skills, a customer-centric approach, and the ability to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own overall relationship with assigned clients from Singapore, which includes managing onboarding, implementation, training, increasing adoption, and high levels of customer satisfaction. 
 Work in the Singapore time zone, and handle key accounts. 
 Liaising with internal departments to ensure client needs are fulfilled effectively.

 Maintain and develop customer success strategies and best practices, as well as customer support content, with the help of the creative team. 
 Stay up-to-date on product development and the latest releases. 
 Conducting business reviews to ensure clients are satisfied with their products and services. 
 Keeping up on trends, changes, and competitor actions that might affect the client. 
 Bring in new ideas and craft approaches to delight our customers. 
 Skills & Requirements 
 6 months to 2+ years experience as a Customer Success or SaaS environment targeting SMBs or enterprise companies. 
 Significant experience in a customer-facing role. (SaaS & Fintech industry would be beneficial). 
 Proactive on how to solve problems or improve processes within the company. 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present and communicate data & issues to senior management. 
 Confidence working with ambiguity, unknown variables, and problem statements (and find ways to bridge those gaps, when necessary). 
 Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to build rapport with customers.

 Benefits 
 Competitive salary with performance-based incentives. 
 Comprehensive benefits package including your health insurance. 
 Remote work flexibility with a supportive and collaborative team environment. 
 Opportunities for career advancement and professional development. 
 Our Culture

We value your independence and trust you with tasks, encouraging you to take ownership and find innovative solutions.

 Ownership: We believe in freedom with responsibility. You'll naturally take the lead and excel.

 The Marketing Analyst Intern role is a remote internship focused on supporting data-driven marketing initiatives across Radora’s product lines and industry segments. Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting and analyzing marketing and sales data, generating performance reports, and identifying trends that inform campaign optimization. The intern will assist in tracking key metrics such as lead generation, conversion rates, and customer engagement, and will help translate findings into clear insights for marketing and product teams. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, preparing presentations and dashboards, and contributing to market research on competitors, customer segments, and emerging technologies. This internship offers exposure to analytics tools, digital marketing practices, and B2B technology markets while working closely with experienced professionals.

 Proficiency with spreadsheets and data visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, or similar) is beneficial.

unstop-1812244.body:
This is going to be a very difficult internship. 
 We're saying that first because it's true but you'll end up learning more in one month than most people learn in a year.
 Learn how a company actually launches 
 We're at day zero: no users, no revenue, no team. In the next 60 days we build the product, sell it to the first customers and get ready to raise. You'll do all three:
 Build: write code with the founder in Claude Code. Build features, wire up the AI agents, test what they produce, and track what every AI call costs, so the product stays cheap enough to run for thousands of customers.
 Sell: build lists of founders who fit our customer and verify their emails. Write and run cold email sequences, book calls, and get on them with founders around the world.
 Raise: turn what customers tell us into the investment thesis. Size the market, map the competition, and work out pricing and unit economics. Then build the deck, the collateral and the data room, and line up investors for January.
 You'll own the area you're strongest in and work on the other two every week. You don't need to be great at all three: you need to be exceptional at one and good enough at the other two. At the end, you'll know how to launch a company, because you'll have done it.
 Face to face with the founder 
 Not a manager. Not a Slack channel. You'll sit across the table from the founder three days a week, at his home office in Indiranagar, Bangalore, and see every decision as it's made: what to build, who to sell to, what to tell investors.
 We're in stealth, so the idea isn't on this page. Get to the interview and you'll hear all of it.
 Who you'd be building with 
 You'll be working directly with the founder - Prannay:
 Started an AI company before ChatGPT existed and sold it within 16 months
 MBA from IIM Calcutta
 Management Consultant at Bain
 Who we're looking for 
 Intent, above all. You know what you want from the next two months, and why this is the way to get it. That matters more to us than anything on your CV.
 You learn fast. You work out what you don't know, and you act on feedback the same day.
 One real strength. You've built, sold or pitched something real, and can show us.
 Good enough at the other two. You can write an email a founder would answer, get something small running with an AI coding tool, and back an argument with real numbers. Never written code? An AI tool will get you started, and you'll learn the rest next to the founder.
 You finish what you start, and you reply the same day.
 If "very difficult" made you lean in, you must apply. Please don't apply if you want a certificate and a quiet month.
 The details 
 Starts: Mon 7 Dec 2026. One month, extendable to two if you earn it. The second month is the raise.
 Pay: ₹30,000–40,000 a month fixed, set by what you show in the process, plus up to 50% more on performance: up to ₹60,000 a month.
 Where: Tue–Thu in person at the founder's home office in Bangalore; Mon and Fri from home (subject to change). Some evening calls in US hours, from home.
 Who: you're already in Bangalore, with no exams, job or other internship during these dates. Final-year students, recent graduates and people between jobs are all welcome.
 Process: a short application, a take-home (about 2½ hours) built around your strongest area, a 45-minute interview, then two paid days working with the founder in Bangalore. Applications close Sun 22 Nov. Everyone who submits the test hears back within 5 days.
 If the test feels like too much work, this internship will too.

amazon-10599671.body:
Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
NOC Overview
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. 
Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
- Undergraduate degree
- Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree, or Bachelor of Arts degree

A day in the life

amazon-10606130.body:
The Amazon Fulfillment Technologies Support Team is looking for a System Dev Engineer who will join the team which supports all software applications responsible for shipment, item availability, customer promises, shipment optimization and other functions related to fulfillment services process.
Your problem resolving skill will benefit customers directly, ensuring Amazon is able to meet all its commitments to our customers. Primary responsibilities include troubleshooting, diagnosing and fixing production software issues, developing monitoring solutions, performing software maintenance and configuration, using AI tools where applicable, implementing the fix for internally developed code (Perl, Ruby, C/C++, JAVA, Python), performing SQL queries, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges, build and develop tools which will automate daily operational activities. Ideal Candidate should have Experience leveraging generative AI (GenAI) tools and large language model (LLM)-based assistants to accelerate software development, debugging, and operational workflows along with Hands-on experience with AI-assisted code generation, code review automation, or AI-powered incident triage tools
Responsibilities also include working alongside development teams on Amazon Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, designing of systems, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems.
Your solutions will impact our customers directly! This job requires you to constantly hit the ground running and your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success. High Impact production issues often require coordination between multiple Development, Operations and IT Support groups, so you get to experience a breadth of impact with various groups.
The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple tasks at once, able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. You must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done.
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Experience with distributed systems at scale

amazon-10602774.body:
Business Data Technologies (BDT) makes it easier for teams across Amazon to produce, store, catalog, secure, move, and analyze data at massive scale. Our managed solutions combine standard AWS tooling, open-source products, and custom services to free teams from worrying about the complexities of operating at Amazon scale. This lets BDT customers move beyond the engineering and operational burden associated with managing and scaling platforms, and instead focus on scaling the value they can glean from their data, both for their customers and their teams.
We own the one of the biggest (largest) data lakes for Amazon where 1000’s of Amazon teams can search, share, and store EB (Exabytes) of data in a secure and seamless way; using our solutions, teams around the world can schedule/process millions of workloads on a daily basis. We provide enterprise solutions that focus on compliance, security, integrity, and cost efficiency of operating and managing EBs of Amazon data.
Key job responsibilities
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:
· Be hands-on with ETL to build data pipelines to support automated reporting
· Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources
· Implement data structures using best practices in data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and SQL, Redshift.
· Model data and metadata for ad-hoc and pre-built reporting
· Interface with business customers, gathering requirements and delivering complete reporting solutions
· Build robust and scalable data integration (ETL) pipelines using SQL, Python and Spark.
· Build and deliver high quality data sets to support business analyst, data scientists, and customer reporting needs.
· Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self-service support for customers
· Participate in strategic & tactical planning discussions
A day in the life
As a Data Engineer, you will be working with cross-functional partners from Science, Product, SDEs, Operations and leadership to translate raw data into actionable insights for stakeholders, empowering them to make data-driven decisions. Some of the key activities include:
Crafting the Data Flow: Design and build data pipelines, the backbone of our data ecosystem.
Ensure the integrity of the data journey by implementing robust data quality checks and monitoring processes.
Architect for Insights: Translate complex business requirements into efficient data models that optimize data analysis and reporting. Automate data processing tasks to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
Become a data detective! ensuring data availability and performance
- 1+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields
- Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role
- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
