unstop-1815918.body:
Associate – NBFC Compliance & Secretarial
 Hiring For: Confidential Client – NBFC / Financial Services
 Employment: Full-Time, Permanent
 Location: M.G. Road, Bengaluru
 Qualification: Qualified Company Secretary (CS)
 Experience: Fresher / 1–2 Years Post-Qualification Experience
 Annual CTC: ₹6,00,000 – ₹7,00,000
 About the Opportunity
 Skills DNA is hiring on behalf of a confidential client operating in the Non-Banking Financial Services sector.
 The client is looking for a Qualified Company Secretary (CS) to support the Compliance, Legal & Secretarial functions of two Middle Layer Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs).
 The role involves corporate secretarial compliance, RBI regulatory filings, statutory compliance, corporate governance and audit coordination. The selected candidate will work closely with the Company Secretary, Chief Compliance Officer (CCO), Finance, Risk, Operations and Legal teams.
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Secretarial & Corporate Compliance
 Assist in organising Board Meetings, Committee Meetings and General Meetings, including preparation of notices, agendas, meeting notes and minutes in accordance with applicable Secretarial Standards.
 Maintain statutory registers, minute books and corporate records.
 Assist with ROC/MCA filings under the Companies Act, 2013, including applicable annual and event-based filings.
 Support director onboarding, KYC, DIN-related compliances and statutory disclosures.
 Track related-party transactions, loans, investments and guarantees, ensuring appropriate approvals and disclosures.
 Monitor annual statutory compliances and filing deadlines.
 2. RBI Regulatory Compliance
 Support compliance with RBI Master Directions, circulars and the Scale Based Regulation framework applicable to Middle Layer NBFCs.
 Assist in preparing and filing periodic RBI regulatory returns through prescribed portals, including CIMS/XBRL.
 Support monitoring of prudential norms, capital adequacy, exposure limits, asset classification, provisioning and liquidity requirements.
 Track RBI regulatory updates and coordinate implementation of applicable requirements.
 Support compliance with Fair Practices Code, outsourcing guidelines, digital lending directions and grievance redressal requirements.
 Assist with KYC/AML/CFT compliance under applicable RBI directions and PMLA, including CKYC, FIU-IND and CERSAI-related requirements.
 Assist in preparing responses to RBI inspections and supervisory queries.
 3. Other Statutory & Regulatory Compliance
 Assist with applicable FEMA reporting and statutory filings.
 Support SEBI-related compliance requirements, including those concerning listed debt instruments, wherever applicable.
 Coordinate with Finance and other teams on applicable tax compliances.
 Monitor applicable labour law requirements and statutory registrations.
 4. Audit, Governance & Reporting
 Coordinate with statutory, internal, secretarial and RBI-appointed auditors.
 Assist in drafting, reviewing and updating internal compliance policies and procedures.
 Identify compliance gaps, coordinate corrective actions and monitor their closure.
 Support compliance testing and monitoring of key business processes.
 Maintain audit-ready documentation and prepare periodic compliance MIS and reports for management and Board review.
 Eligibility & Required Skills
 Qualified Company Secretary (CS) is mandatory.
 Freshly qualified CS candidates are eligible to apply.
 Candidates with 1–2 years of relevant post-qualification experience are also welcome.
 Relevant experience in NBFCs, banking, financial services, compliance, secretarial practice or audit/advisory firms will be preferred.
 Working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, relevant rules and Secretarial Standards.
 Understanding of RBI regulations, NBFC Master Directions and the Scale Based Regulation framework.
 Basic understanding of KYC/AML and PMLA requirements.
 Familiarity with FEMA, SEBI regulations and applicable tax laws will be an advantage.
 Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
 Familiarity with MCA V3, RBI CIMS/XBRL and compliance management tools will be an advantage.
 Strong drafting, documentation, analytical and communication skills.
 High attention to detail, professional integrity and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
 Working Schedule
 Work Mode: Work from Office
 Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday
 Weekly Off: Sundays and 2nd & 4th Saturdays off
 Interested candidates can apply through Skills DNA's recruitment process.

amazon-10606874.body:
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion. 
Key job responsibilities
• Act as the primary point of contact between Amazon's internal teams and North America (NA) business customers to validate and confirm accurate address and location details.
• Apply a strong eye for detail to research, verify, and update correct address and geo-coordinate information in Geo Studio.
• Process a high volume of Address ID's within defined time windows while consistently maintaining a quality bar of 98% or higher.
• Communicate fluently and confidently in English (verbal and written) when speaking with NA business customers to resolve address discrepancies.
• Identify patterns in flagged Address ID's (e.g., incorrect pins, missing business hours, vacant locations) and escalate data gaps to the relevant teams.
• Use internal tools (Geo Studio, SIM, Connect) to research, validate, and correct address and location data.
• Track personal productivity and quality metrics daily; consistently meet Address ID handling volume and accuracy targets.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to reduce recurring address errors and improve overall data quality.
- • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
- • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; comfortable speaking directly with North America based business customers.
- • Strong attention to detail with the ability to research and validate data accurately.
- • Working knowledge of Excel and basic data analysis tools.
- • Ability to work in a fast-paced, metric-driven, 24/7 shift-based environment.
- • Familiarity with Geo Studio, SIM, or similar Amazon internal tools.
- • Experience working directly with external or business customers over phone or email.
- • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP) and exposure to QuickSight.

unstop-1817903.body:
Job Description & Key Responsibilities 
 The Field Sales Executive will be responsible for developing business opportunities, acquiring new customers, managing existing accounts, and driving sales growth across assigned territories.
 Key responsibilities include: 
 Identify and develop potential customers and explore new business opportunities.
 Generate sales leads through direct field visits, networking, references, and market research.
 Approach prospective customers, understand their requirements, present product specifications, and effectively communicate the value of the company's products.
 Arrange and conduct face-to-face meetings with prospective and existing customers.
 Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and delivery schedules to successfully close sales.
 Convert business opportunities into confirmed purchase orders and ensure timely collection of advance payments.
 Coordinate with the Production Department to ensure proper execution of customer orders.
 Monitor order status and ensure timely delivery of machines as committed to customers.
 Follow up on pending payments and coordinate with the Accounts Department to ensure timely collections.
 Build and maintain strong customer relationships through regular communication and periodic visits.
 Coordinate with the Service Department to address customer complaints, service requirements, and after-sales support.
 Job Requirements & Expectations 
 This is a 100% field-oriented sales position involving extensive travel across India, with occasional visits to the office for meetings and reviews.
 Candidates from any part of India are welcome to apply.
 Applicants must have a strong interest in marketing, sales, customer interaction, and business development.
 Excellent communication skills in Hindi and English are mandatory . Knowledge of at least one additional regional language will be an added advantage.
 Candidates should be confident in meeting customers personally, negotiating business deals, and independently developing sales opportunities.
 Willingness to travel extensively and work independently in assigned territories is essential.
 Salary, Incentives & Benefits 
 Attractive salary package based on the candidate's experience, capabilities, and suitability for the role.
 Additional performance-based incentives for successful sales closures.
 Travel expenses will be reimbursed by the company as per its approved travel and expense policy.
 Earning potential of up to ₹80,000 per month , depending on sales performance, business conversion, and applicable incentives.

 Freshers, students, and recent graduates who are proactive, responsible, comfortable with vendor coordination, and enthusiastic about managing live events are encouraged to apply.

unstop-1817814.body:
We are looking for a qualified and experienced Company Secretary (CS) to independently manage corporate compliance, statutory requirements, IPO-related activities, corporate projects, and legal documentation.
 The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of corporate laws, regulatory compliance, IPO procedures, and corporate governance, along with the ability to coordinate with Management, regulatory authorities, consultants, and other stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Independently manage corporate secretarial functions, statutory compliance, and regulatory requirements under the Companies Act, 2013.
 Handle MCA/ROC filings, annual returns, statutory registers, Board meetings, resolutions, minutes, and corporate documentation.
 Coordinate IPO-related activities , including IPO readiness, due diligence, regulatory compliance, documentation, and coordination with merchant bankers, auditors, legal advisors, and consultants.
 Assist Management with IPO planning, fundraising, capital restructuring, and other corporate financial activities.
 Manage and coordinate corporate projects , including business expansion, new company formation, investments, and strategic business initiatives.
 Coordinate project-related approvals, government permissions, regulatory documentation, and statutory requirements.
 Monitor applicable SEBI regulations, corporate governance requirements, and changes in corporate laws.
 Assist in drafting and reviewing legal agreements, contracts, corporate policies, and related documentation.
 Liaise with regulatory authorities, financial institutions, consultants, and other external stakeholders.
 Maintain compliance calendars, project tracking records, and MIS reports for Management.
 Identify compliance risks, regulatory issues, and project delays, and ensure timely follow-up and resolution.
 Maintain confidentiality of corporate, legal, financial, and Management information.
 Key Qualifications & Requirements 
 Qualified Company Secretary (CS) with valid ICSI membership – Mandatory. 
 Freshers to 6 years of relevant experience in corporate compliance, secretarial functions, IPO-related activities, or corporate projects.
 Strong knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, MCA/ROC filings, corporate governance, and applicable SEBI regulations.
 Practical experience in IPO preparation, due diligence, regulatory documentation, or fundraising will be strongly preferred.
 Experience coordinating with merchant bankers, auditors, legal advisors, and regulatory authorities.
 Good drafting, documentation, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
 Proficiency in MS Office and MCA portal operations.
 LL.B., finance-related qualifications, or experience in manufacturing companies will be an added advantage.

Job Description: Business Development Intern (Remote)
 Company: ROI Boosters
 Location: Remote
 Employment Type: Internship

 Working Hours: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
 Monthly Stipend: ₹12,000
 Paid Trial Period: 15 working days at ₹5,000
 Minimum Commitment: 3 months
 About ROI Boosters 
 ROI Boosters is a Gurugram-based paid media agency focused on delivering measurable business growth through performance marketing. Our team of 25 professionals manages advertising campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Bing for brands across the US, Europe, and the UAE.
 We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Business Development Intern to help identify potential clients, initiate conversations, and support our client acquisition efforts.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead Generation: Research brands investing $3,000 or more per month in paid advertising and identify potential business opportunities.
 Prospect Research: Identify key decision-makers, including founders and marketing heads, within target companies.
 Outreach & Follow-ups: Draft personalised emails and LinkedIn messages and follow up with prospects systematically.
 Proposal Writing: Prepare proposals for relevant projects on platforms such as Upwork and Fiverr.
 Sales Support: Assist with discovery call preparation, research, meeting notes, and follow-up communication.
 Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate records of leads, outreach activities, responses, and follow-up schedules.
 Daily Reporting: Submit concise end-of-day reports through Slack, highlighting completed tasks, progress, and pending activities.
 Continuous Improvement: Incorporate feedback to improve outreach quality, personalisation, and overall business development performance.
 All outreach messages and proposals will be reviewed, with regular feedback provided to support learning and improvement.
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Strong written English and the ability to communicate professionally.
 High reliability, punctuality, and consistency in completing assigned tasks.
 Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions accurately.
 Willingness to learn sales outreach, lead generation, and client acquisition.
 Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
 Must have a laptop and a stable internet connection.
 Must be available Monday to Saturday, from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, for a minimum of three months.
 Freshers are welcome to apply. Prior experience in sales, freelancing, social media, content writing, or business development is an advantage but not mandatory.
 What We Offer 
 Hands-on training in agency business development and client acquisition.
 Exposure to international brands and performance marketing across five major advertising platforms.
 Regular feedback and guidance to help improve research, writing, and sales skills.
 Practical experience with tools such as ClickUp and Slack.
 Opportunity to progress into a Business Development Executive role based on performance.
 Internship completion certificate and recommendation upon successful completion of the internship.
 Compensation & Internship Terms 
 Monthly stipend: ₹12,000.
 Initial paid trial: 15 working days with compensation of ₹5,000.
 Minimum internship commitment: 3 months.
 Work mode: Fully remote.
 Working schedule: Monday to Saturday, 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST.
 The paid trial period will be used to evaluate consistency, communication, attention to detail, and ability to execute assigned tasks.
 Selection Process 
 Application Form: Complete the application form with accurate information and the required documents.
 Email Task & HR Interview: Complete a short email-writing task, followed by a 35-minute video interview with HR. Candidates must join using a laptop, keep their camera on, and be prepared to share their screen.
 Practical Assignment: Complete a 48-hour business development assignment requiring approximately three hours of work in total.
 CEO Interview: Attend a 30-minute video interview with the CEO, including a mock sales call.
 Paid Trial: Successfully complete a 15-working-day paid trial with daily end-of-day reporting.
 Important Expectations 
 Business development requires persistence. Many outreach messages may not receive a response, and candidates must be comfortable with rejection and repetitive follow-ups. We value consistent effort, accountability, attention to detail, and willingness to improve over occasional high performance.

unstop-1817655.body:
Company — Delta Minds Research
 Location — Remote, India
 Duration — 1–31 December 2026
 Schedule — One hour of live guidance per working day, plus hands-on project work
 About Delta Minds Research 
 Delta Minds Research is a market research and consulting company that helps businesses understand market trends, competitive landscapes, and growth opportunities.
 About the role 
 You’ll work on a supervised market research project from start to finish. You’ll clean a dataset, write SQL queries to compare market segments and regions, and build an interactive Power BI dashboard. You’ll use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to draft queries and troubleshoot errors, then verify your results against the source data before presenting your findings.
 What you’ll do 
 Excel — Clean and validate market research data, then summarize it with pivot tables.
 SQL — Use filters, joins, and aggregations to answer questions about market size and growth.
 Power BI — Prepare data with Power Query, create basic DAX measures, and build an interactive dashboard.
 Tableau — Create a visualization that communicates one finding from your analysis.
 AI-assisted analysis — Use AI to develop and debug queries, document your workflow, and catch errors in AI-generated output.
 Present your findings — Explain what your dashboard shows, how you checked the numbers, and where the data has limitations.
 Who can apply

amazon-10606855.body:
This team enables automation at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. This team serves Amazon Internal Fulfillment Technologies & Robotics teams by enabling automation, which includes real-time & offline (image/video) data auditing services. One of the key contributions of this team is supporting the fulfillment centers in maintaining inventory accuracy.
An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.
Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee
The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.
A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
About the team
Data Auditing Operations team provides human support to Amazon Fulfillment facilities with goal of enabling hands-free active stowing through visual audits on videos/images. Videos with brief duration (typically between 15 and 20seconds) are sent to Operations Team for humans to audit them with information on products being stored at fulfilment centers. For business use, these videos must be thoroughly reviewed and audited using best human judgement. The effectiveness of automated process will be increased by using videos that Associates have audited. This process helps maintaining stow quality at fulfillment center and Associate will be further evaluated for performance improvements/coaching.
- Bachelor's degree
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.

Essential Responsibilities:

• Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon

• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
• Address and respond to sensitive situations
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
• Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
• Other duties as assigned

- 1+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

amazon-10607963.body:
Are you interested in working on the next generation of Amazon buildings? Do you want to be part of the ongoing growth and expansion of Amazon’s infrastructure? Do you want to be a Subject Matter Expert concerning simulations for multiple miles and countries? Are you reluctant to apply because you’re concerned you don’t have the right qualifications? The Global Engineering Services Team has a full training plan and support network to help you grow and succeed within this role. The International Engineering Programs team is seeking an experienced Amazon Simulations and Optimization engineer to join the team to support the expansion of simulations engineering. The Simulations and Optimization engineer is a key player in the end-to-end delivery of the complex challenge of launching new buildings – or optimizing existing buildings, driving improvements and standards to enable new sites to achieve benchmark rates while ramping to meet network capacity. In this role, you will influence a team comprising of Site Leads, Senior Operations Managers, Operation Managers, Project Managers, Process SMEs, Design Engineers and as well as representatives of various key stakeholder. Furthermore, the team is expanding to support international expansion, working across EU, MENA, India, LATAM, Australia. We collaborate with colleagues in North America to maintain global excellence in simulation services and models. This role calls for an individual who is knowledgeable concerning Yard and Under The Roof operations, structured, confident and professionally and socially adept to earn credibility and trust with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization. The role requires to travel up to 20%.
Key job responsibilities
• Will have the ability to deal and deliver results in an ambiguous environment concerning sites Operations and Yard
 • Is able to support infrastructure and flow related simulations to derive infrastructure requirements – softwares: Siemens Plan Simulation X, Flexsim
• Is able to provide design inputs based data driven methodology
 • Interpersonal skills, to motivate and lead expectations and outcomes to project team.
 • Communication skills to build relationships and identify with stakeholders across the organization.
 • Is able to use their initiative and make decisions under pressure.
 • Has the ability to seek opportunities to drive year on year savings and performance/process improvements.
 • Will compile, manage and report on weekly project metrics and be responsible for leading many high-profile meetings to align on project requirements.
• Working backwards from True North processes and available data to close the gaps from current to desired state,
• Create Material Flow Diagrams,
• Provide data driven process and engineering related advice to the leadership by written narrative business document
 • Has the ability to learn and adapt to changing circumstances.
 • Has Fulfillment Center and/or Sort Center operational skills
A day in the life
In cooperation with other GES stakeholders, including but not limited to WWRE & Design, ACES/PE, AR, Ops, and others the team aims to optimize building designs, modules, and processes, in ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and AA experience related to sites innovation and design. They will ensure our future buildings, retrofits and expansions will both attend to the operational excellence requirements and have frugal solutions.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Experience with Simulations of automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing – Siemens Plant Simulation X or Flexsim,
- Experience with concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, and decision making
- Experience must involve ownership/management of engineering design projects, along with Experience using business/technical software like MS Excel, MS Project, and CAD software
- Experience with process design based on Lean Principles, along with experience in Capital project management,

unstop-1819647.body:
A Customer Care Executive (CCE) acts as the primary frontline link between an organization and its customers, handling inbound and outbound communications to drive satisfaction, loyalty, and brand reputation.
 Responsibilities: 
 Multi-Channel Support: Respond to customer queries, requests, and complaints via phone calls, emails, live chat, and social media channels. 
 Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot product or service problems, process replacements or refunds, and handle billing or delivery escalations. 
 Data Logging: Maintain accurate records of interactions, feedback, and support tickets using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools like Salesforce or Zendesk. 
 Product Guidance: Educate customers on product features, usage guidelines, and company policies. 
 Cross-Selling & Upselling: Identify opportunities to recommend relevant add-ons or upgraded services. 
 Follow-Ups: Contact customers after issue resolution or post-purchase to ensure satisfaction and gather feedback. 
 Requirements: 
 Communication Excellence: Fluent and articulate spoken English with the ability to draft clear, polite, and professional written correspondence. 
 Active Listening: Attentive listener skilled at identifying root customer needs and asking targeted questions to resolve issues efficiently. 
 Patience & De-escalation: Exceptional emotional composure when handling difficult, frustrated, or demanding customer interactions. 
 Problem-Solving & Decision Making: Strong analytical mindset focused on delivering swift, accurate, and effective solutions to customer problems. 
 Technical Literacy: Hands-on proficiency in CRM tools, ticketing systems, and customer support databases.

About Mellow Vault: Mellow Vault (operated under Prayukti Development Pvt. Ltd.) is a fast-growing talent acquisition, technical assessment, and IT recruitment platform based in Noida. We bridge the gap between final-year IT students, working professionals, academic institutions, and hiring employers—streamlining candidate evaluation, upskilling, and direct job placements.
 Role Overview: We are hiring a results-driven Marketing & Outreach Executive to spearhead our institutional, corporate, and candidate acquisition efforts from our Noida Sector 132 office. You will own outbound calling, college placement partnerships, employer outreach, and community growth—playing a direct role in scaling Mellow Vault’s user base and hiring network.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Institutional & College Outreach: Connect with Training & Placement Officers (TPOs), Heads of Departments (HODs), and university placement cells across India to pitch Mellow Vault’s student assessment and placement partnerships (MOU closures).
 Outbound Calling & Lead Conversion: Execute high-intent outbound calls and follow-ups with colleges, IT employers, and jobseekers to drive registrations, webinar attendance, and platform onboarding.
 Multi-Channel Campaigns: Run structured outreach via phone calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and email to build a consistent pipeline of partners and candidates.
 Campus & Community Growth: Coordinate campus ambassador programs, virtual career drives, and onboarding campaigns for final-year IT students and freshers.
 Pipeline & CRM Management: Maintain accurate records of daily calls, partner conversations, and conversion metrics in Google Sheets/CRM, reporting weekly progress to the leadership team.
 Requirements & Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (BBA, MBA, B.Tech, B.Com, Mass Communication, or related fields preferred).
 0–2 years of experience in outbound sales, B2B/B2C outreach, telecalling, campus marketing, or EdTech/HR-Tech business development.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi , with confidence on phone calls and virtual meetings.
 Target-oriented mindset with strong negotiation, persuasion, and follow-up discipline.
 Proficiency in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Meet), LinkedIn, and WhatsApp Business workflows.
 What We Offer: 
 Competitive fixed salary + uncapped performance-linked incentives.
 Direct mentorship and daily collaboration with the founding and marketing leadership team.
 Fast-track career growth into Team Lead / Partnership Manager roles as Mellow Vault scales.
 Dynamic startup work environment at our Sector 132, Noida office.

unstop-1819596.body:
Overview: 
 We are looking for a motivated and curious Associate AI Engineer to join our growing AI team.
 This role is ideal for recent graduates or early-career professionals (up to 1 year of experience) with strong Python fundamentals and a genuine interest in Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies.
 You will work alongside experienced engineers on real-world projects involving AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and cloud technologies. This is a hands-on learning role with structured mentorship and a clear path to growth as an AI Engineer.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Development 
 Write clean, well-structured Python code for applications, scripts, and AI-powered features. 
 Assist in building Generative AI and LLM-based applications using APIs from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini. 
 Support the development of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, including data preparation, embeddings, and vector search. 
 Contribute to building AI agents and automated workflows under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 Practice prompt engineering, structured outputs, and tool/function calling techniques. 
 Integration and Data 
 Work with REST APIs, JSON data, and databases to integrate AI capabilities into applications. 
 Assist in building simple backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. 
 Clean, process, and prepare data for AI and ML tasks. 
 Testing and Deployment 
 Test, debug, and troubleshoot assigned modules and features. 
 Help evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, and quality. 
 Gain exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Docker, and deployment workflows. 
 Collaboration and Learning 
 Understand project requirements and collaborate closely with senior team members. 
 Participate in code reviews, team discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. 
 Maintain clear documentation of code, experiments, and project work. 
 Continuously learn new tools, frameworks, and techniques as AI technologies evolve. 
 Required Skills: 
 Strong understanding of Python fundamentals, including data structures, functions, OOP, and error handling. 
 Good grasp of core programming concepts and logical problem-solving. 
 Basic knowledge of AI/ML concepts, gained through academics, internships, courses, or personal projects. 
 Familiarity with Generative AI and LLMs (for example, using an LLM API or building a simple chatbot). 
 Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, and working with data. 
 Familiarity with Git and GitHub. 
 Good analytical skills and attention to detail. 
 Clear written and verbal communication. 
 A strong willingness to learn and adapt quickly. 
 Good to Have: 
 Hands-on project experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar frameworks. 
 Exposure to vector databases such as ChromaDB, FAISS, Pinecone, or Qdrant. 
 Familiarity with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or Hugging Face Transformers. 
 Interest in or basic understanding of Agentic AI concepts and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 Basic exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Docker. 
 Basic SQL knowledge. 
 Relevant certifications, hackathon participation, Kaggle work, or open-source contributions. 
 A GitHub profile or portfolio showcasing AI or Python projects. 
 Educational Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 Academic, internship, or personal projects involving Python, AI/ML, Generative AI, or cloud technologies will be strongly considered. 
 What We’re Looking For: 
 Strong fundamentals, a solid educational background, and a problem-solving mindset. 
 Candidates who can explain their academic or personal projects clearly, including what they built, the tools they used, and what they learned. 
 Curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-evolving field. 
 Extensive professional experience is not required; we value potential, attitude, and a passion for building with AI.

 Responsibilities 
 Coordinate the founder’s calendar, appointments, meetings, reminders, and professional commitments; prepare agendas and maintain meeting notes and minutes.

 Excellent written and spoken English, including professional email drafting, proofreading, grammar, and business etiquette, is essential.

 Working knowledge of MS Office, Google Workspace, Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Meet, and presentation tools is beneficial.
 Candidates should be based in Pune or Mumbai and comfortable with the hybrid schedule and occasional coordination across Indian and British office timings.

 This is a six-month, full-time, paid internship with a monthly stipend of ₹10,000–₹12,000. Candidates who demonstrate commendable performance, professionalism, dedication, and ownership may receive a Certificate of Appreciation. Strong performance may also lead to a job offer. The internship provides practical exposure to executive management, media relations, international coordination, and professional business communication.

unstop-1818561.body:
About us 
 Sojaru Corp is a digital agency based in India. We work with 120+ clients across India and the US, and we run ads, content and SEO for their brands. As part of our team, you’ll work on a healthcare and aesthetics client, a doctor-led aesthetic, laser and ENT clinic in West Delhi. We want to reach more patients online, so we need someone who can run ads and make content people actually watch.
 Roles and responsibilities 
 Plan, launch and optimise Google Ads (Search, Local/Maps) to generate patient enquiries and appointments
 Plan, launch and optimise Meta Ads (Instagram and Facebook) for leads and bookings
 Own a real ad budget (details below) and decide where to spend it
 Come up with ideas, write scripts and shoot Instagram Reels : treatment walkthroughs, doctor explainers, myth vs fact, FAQs, behind-the-scenes and patient stories (only with consent)
 Manage the Google Business Profile : weekly posts, photos, Q&A, review requests and replies, local SEO
 Build a monthly content calendar and keep posting consistent
 Track and report results every month: leads, cost per lead, bookings, reach, watch time, saves and shares
 Make sure all ads and content follow Google and Meta healthcare advertising policies
 Your own ad budget 
 You will be given a fixed ad budget of ₹20,000 to ₹30,000 to run the campaigns.
 You decide where to spend it: which platform, which campaign type, which audience, how much per day, and when to shift money.
 Your analytical thinking decides the results. We will supervise, but we won’t spoon-feed you or force any decision on you.
 You will see real cost per click, cost per lead and cost per booking, and learn to get the most out of every rupee.
 Requirements 
 Good understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads (campaign types, targeting, bidding, budgets, conversion tracking and optimisation)
 Ability to write hooks and short scripts for Reels
 Comfortable shooting and editing on a phone (CapCut / InShot / VN)
 Basic knowledge of Google Business Profile and local SEO
 Understanding of what drives reach on Instagram (watch time, saves, shares)
 Good communication in Hindi and English
 Good to have 
 Experience with any brand campaign (clinic, salon, skincare, healthcare or any other industry)
 Basic Canva skills
 Knowledge of Meta Pixel, conversion tracking or WhatsApp lead flows
 Use of AI 
 We don’t discourage the use of AI. You will use it throughout the job to speed up research, scripting, reporting and analysis. What we care about is your thinking, so please keep your screening answers original.
 What you get 
 ₹8,000 per month stipend 
 Internship certificate
 Letter of Recommendation based on performance
 Hands-on control of a real ad budget of ₹20,000 to ₹30,000, with supervision instead of micromanagement
 Direct exposure to live campaigns for a real client
 Hybrid work with flexible hours
 Freedom to test ideas and build a portfolio with measurable results
 Screening task 
 This should take about 20 to 30 minutes. Answer in your own words, in English or Hindi, whichever you prefer . We will assess your thinking through your answers.
 AI is fine, copy-paste is not. You can use AI to help you think, but the ideas must be original and reflect your own understanding. Generic template answers will not stand out.
 Portfolio: Previous Reels, ads or campaigns are welcome but not mandatory . You can share them if you have them. We also accept fresh work made for this application.
 Share an idea: Give us one Reel idea for a skin or laser clinic (2 to 3 lines is enough).
 Write 3 hooks and 1 script: Write 3 Reel hooks and one 30-second script for a laser hair reduction or skin treatment video.
 Imagine a clinic in Delhi: In 5 lines, tell us how you would get more enquiries for the clinic in the first 30 days.
 Your ad budget: Imagine you are given ₹25,000 to bring patient enquiries to this clinic. Tell us in your own words:
 Where would you spend it (Google Search, Google Maps/Local, Instagram, Facebook) and roughly how much on each?
 What would you track in the first week, and what would make you move money from one place to another?
 Note: Freshers are welcome. Your answers are used only to assess your thinking, not for client work.

unstop-1817661.body:
About the Role 
 MyOnline Vakeel is inviting applications from enthusiastic and research-oriented law students for the position of Legal Assessment Intern .
 The selected interns will work with the legal team to assess corporate legal requirements, conduct legal research, analyse business-related legal issues, and assist in evaluating legal documentation and compliance requirements.
 This internship is designed to provide practical exposure to corporate law and help candidates develop the ability to identify, understand, and assess legal issues arising in business operations.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Corporate Legal Research: Research the Companies Act, 2013, LLP Act, Contract Act, and other relevant corporate and commercial laws.
 Legal Assessment: Analyse business-related legal queries and identify applicable laws, legal requirements, and potential solutions.
 Company Law & Compliance: Assist in understanding and assessing company incorporation, ROC compliances, statutory filings, and other corporate legal requirements.
 Contract Review: Assist in reviewing and analysing agreements, NDAs, MOUs, service agreements, employment agreements, and other commercial contracts.
 Legal Documentation: Assist in preparing legal drafts, research notes, compliance checklists, case summaries, and assessment reports.
 Business Legal Advisory Support: Understand the legal requirements of startups, entrepreneurs, and established businesses and assist the legal team in assessing their requirements.
 Due Diligence: Assist in preliminary legal document verification and identification of potential legal risks.
 Legal Problem-Solving: Evaluate practical business scenarios and suggest research-backed legal approaches under the supervision of the legal team.
 Research & Reporting: Prepare structured reports and maintain records of legal research and assessments.
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Students pursuing a 3-year LL.B. or 5-year integrated law programme.
 Preference for candidates interested in Corporate Law, Commercial Law, and Business Compliance.
 Willingness to learn and work in a professional legal consultancy environment.
 Basic understanding of Indian legal frameworks.
 Good legal research and analytical skills.
 Strong written communication and drafting abilities.
 Familiarity with online legal research platforms.
 Skills Required 
 Legal Research & Analysis
 Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving
 Legal Drafting
 Attention to Detail
 Communication
 Teamwork & Responsibility
 Client Handling
 Time Management
 Confidentiality and Professional Ethics
 Punctuality and discipline.
 Willingness to learn.
 Adaptability.

amazon-10609161.body:
This team enables automation at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. This team serves Amazon Internal Fulfillment Technologies & Robotics teams by enabling automation, which includes real-time & offline (image/video) data auditing services. One of the key contributions of this team is supporting the fulfillment centers in maintaining inventory accuracy.
An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.
Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee
The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.
A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
About the team
Data Auditing Operations team provides human support to Amazon Fulfillment facilities with goal of enabling hands-free active stowing through visual audits on videos/images. Videos with brief duration (typically between 15 and 20seconds) are sent to Operations Team for humans to audit them with information on products being stored at fulfilment centers. For business use, these videos must be thoroughly reviewed and audited using best human judgement. The effectiveness of automated process will be increased by using videos that Associates have audited. This process helps maintaining stow quality at fulfillment center and Associate will be further evaluated for performance improvements/coaching.
- Bachelor's degree
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

amazon-10595195.body:
The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate(DE) is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies. 
Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. Compliance Associate(DE), your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.
Skills:
• Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)
• Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database
• Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions
• Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information
• Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking
• Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts
• Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data
About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

• Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
• Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
• Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
• Address and respond to sensitive situations
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
• Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
• Other duties as assigned
- Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- 1+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Master's degree or above
- Experience handling confidential information
- Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards
- • Experience and knowledge in Six Sigma belts and process improvement initiatives
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. unstop-1820690.body:
Job Highlights 
 Experience with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), strong knowledge of Generative AI, LLM APIs, Python, and API integrations
 Design, build, and deploy AI agents for content, research, and reporting automation; integrate data sources and tools; monitor and debug workflows
 Job description 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an AI Agent Engineer who can design, build, and deploy AI agents to automate content creation, research, and reporting workflows across our e-commerce operations. The ideal candidate is hands-on with agentic AI frameworks and LLM APIs, comfortable integrating multiple data sources and tools, and motivated to replace manual, repetitive work with reliable automated pipelines. 
 Focus: AI Agents & Agentic Frameworks, Generative AI/LLMs, Python, APIs, Content Automation, Research Automation, and Reporting Automation. 
   Roles & Responsibilities Agent Development & Deployment 
 Design, build, and deploy AI agents using agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar) for real business workflows. 
 Architect multi-step agent pipelines that plan, call tools/APIs, and self-correct with minimal supervision.
 Monitor deployed agents and automated workflows in production; identify, debug, and fix errors or failures.
 Content Automation 
 Use LLMs and AI tools to automate content creation product titles, descriptions, specifications, keywords, and marketing copy.
 Build automation for product data collection, cleaning, categorization, attribute mapping, and validation.
 Work with AI-based image processing, enhancement, background removal, and image generation tools.
 Research Automation 
 Build agents that gather and summarize market, competitor, and product research from multiple online sources.
 Automate structured extraction of research findings into usable formats for the marketing and merchandising teams.
 Reporting & Analytics Automation 
 Build agent-driven tools for sales, inventory, pricing, and product performance reporting.
 Automate recurring reports (e.g., SEO, PPC, marketplace performance) by pulling data via APIs/Sheets and generating LLM-summarized outputs.
 Integrate with reporting tools such as Google Sheets/Looker Studio or Power BI where relevant.
 Integration & Data 
 Integrate internal systems and external platforms (marketplaces, portals, tools) using REST APIs and webhooks.
 Automate product uploads/updates across marketplace and internal portals.
 Work with product catalogues and structured/unstructured data in Excel, CSV, JSON, and SQL.
 Build AI-based solutions to support customer query handling.
 Collaboration & Documentation 
 Collaborate with business and operations teams to translate requirements into automation solutions.
 Maintain clear documentation for agent workflows, APIs, and automation logic.
 Continuously evaluate new AI/automation tools and recommend practical adoption.
 Key Skills Required 
 Good working knowledge of Python.
 Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or the OpenAI/Claude Agents SDKs (at least one required).
 Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
 Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar).
 Familiarity with RAG pipelines and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, FAISS) is a plus.
 Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and third-party API integrations.
 Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or Power Automate.
 Good knowledge of Excel/CSV and structured data handling; basic SQL.
 Knowledge of AI-based image processing/generation tools is an advantage.
 Understanding of e-commerce platforms or marketplace integrations is an advantage.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert business requirements into working technical solutions.
 Strong learning ability and willingness to work with new AI tools and technologies.
 Preferred Experience 
 1-2 years of experience in AI/AI-agentic development, GenAI, automation, Python, or API integration is preferred; strong candidates with fewer years but substantial hands-on agentic AI projects will also be considered.
 Candidates with demonstrable personal or academic projects involving AI agents or automation pipelines (e.g., a GitHub repo or portfolio) will be preferred.

unstop-1819012.body:
About Dr.CURA+ 
 Dr.CURA+ is a new clinical skincare brand built for Indian skin and Indian weather. We start with the problems people have most, like acne, oily skin and dark spots, and solve them with simple regimes backed by real proof instead of hype. We're getting ready to launch on Amazon, Nykaa, Flipkart, Blinkit and Zepto.
 About the role 
 This is a Founder's Office role. You'll work directly with the founder across marketing, brand strategy and social media, and help build Dr.CURA+ from day zero. Expect a mix of hands-on content execution and strategic work on how we position, launch and grow the brand.
 What you'll do 
 Marketing & Strategy 
 Work with the founder on brand positioning, launch plans and go-to-market across marketplaces and quick commerce.
 Track competitors and category trends (D2C skincare, Amazon, Nykaa, quick commerce) and turn them into clear insights and recommendations.
 Help plan and run launch campaigns: messaging, offers, timelines and marketplace creatives (A+ content, thumbnails, listings).
 Build simple trackers and decks for weekly reviews, and own follow-ups on founder-led projects with agencies, creators and vendors.
 Social Media & Content 
 Plan and run Instagram, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn: build the content calendar and handle posting, captions and hashtags.
 Turn skincare science into simple, scroll-stopping content: ingredient explainers, "Step 1 → Step 2" regime videos, myth-busters, before/after concepts.
 Script and shoot reels, often on your phone: routines, product demos, unboxings, trending formats.
 Write in English and Hinglish so we speak to buyers in Tier 1 through Tier 3 cities.
 Help with creator and dermatologist collaborations: shortlist micro-influencers, write briefs, track deliverables.
 Manage the community: reply to DMs and comments, and flag common skin questions to the product team.
 Track performance every week (reach, saves, shares, follower growth) and suggest what to double down on.
 You're a fit if you 
 Think like a marketer and a strategist: you can explain why a brand, post or campaign worked, and what you'd do next.
 Live on Instagram and Reels and understand what makes content travel.
 Write sharp, short copy and are comfortable on camera, or at least behind it.
 Are structured and comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and simple decks.
 Can edit in CapCut, InShot or VN, and design in Canva. Basic Premiere or After Effects is a bonus.
 Care about skincare and know (or want to learn) the difference between Niacinamide and Salicylic Acid.
 Respect facts: no fake claims, no copy-paste from competitors.
 Good to have 
 A personal page or portfolio with some traction, or past marketing/strategy project work.
 Basic idea of Meta Business Suite and Instagram Insights.
 Awareness of ASCI influencer-disclosure guidelines.
 Eligibility & location 
 Final-year students or fresh grads (2025/2026), any stream. Marketing, Management, Mass Comm, Design or Life Sciences preferred. Open only to candidates based in Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad). Must be available full-time, in-office in Gurugram, for 6 months starting immediately.
 What you get 
 Stipend: ₹10,000/month (fixed)
 A seat in the Founder's Office for a brand launch from zero to one, working directly with the founder.
 A certificate and letter of recommendation.
 Free product, and real campaigns and strategy work for your portfolio.
 A shot at a pre-placement offer (PPO) based on performance.

unstop-1814532.body:
Aakaar 2027 | IIT Bombay 
 About Aakaar 
 Aakaar is the annual festival of the Department of Civil Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay) and is recognised as Asia's Largest Civil Engineering Departmental Festival . Since its inception in 2009, Aakaar has provided a dynamic platform for students to explore the diverse dimensions of civil engineering, showcase their technical abilities and engage with the latest developments in the field.
 Aakaar brings together an exciting blend of technical competitions, workshops, expert lecture series, panel discussions, exhibitions and research symposiums. From challenging engineering problems and innovative design challenges to hands-on learning experiences and interactions with industry leaders, the festival offers students an opportunity to learn, compete, innovate and connect beyond the classroom.
 College Representative (CR) Internship 
 Be the face of Aakaar at your college! 
 The College Representative (CR) Internship is a nationwide initiative that connects Aakaar with students across colleges in India. As a CR, you become an important link between Aakaar and your college community, helping students discover exciting opportunities, participate in various events and become a part of Asia's largest Civil Engineering festival.
 This is your opportunity to take the lead, represent IIT Bombay's flagship Civil Engineering festival and become part of a vibrant network of student representatives from across the country.
 Why Become a College Representative? 
 Leadership & Management: Develop leadership, communication, coordination and organisational skills through practical responsibilities.
 Networking Opportunities: Connect with fellow representatives, students and the Aakaar community across India.
 Professional Growth: Gain valuable experience in event promotion, coordination and community engagement.
 Recognition: Get recognised for your contributions and performance while representing Aakaar at your college.
 Real-World Experience: Apply your skills beyond the classroom and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities.
 Exciting Incentives & Rewards 
 Your dedication deserves recognition! At Aakaar, we believe in rewarding enthusiasm, commitment and outstanding performance. The CR Internship comes with exciting incentives designed to make your journey both rewarding and memorable.
 Here's what awaits you: 
 Prizes Worth ₹50,000+: Compete with CRs from across the country, climb the leaderboard and win exciting prizes worth ₹50,000+ through your performance and contributions.
 Free Premium Courses: Get complimentary access to premium courses and learning resources to enhance your skills and support your professional development.
 Exclusive Aakaar Merchandise: Receive exciting Aakaar merchandise and represent the festival with pride.
 Special Gift Hampers: Stand a chance to win specially curated gift hampers, goodies and exclusive rewards.
 Internship Certificate: Earn an official Internship Certificate from Aakaar, IIT Bombay, recognising your successful participation and contribution.
 Letter of Recommendation: Get an opportunity to receive a Letter of Recommendation from Aakaar, IIT Bombay, based on your performance.
 Unstop Pro Benefits: Get access to special discounts on Unstop Pro vouchers and additional benefits.
 Exclusive IIT Bombay Campus Visit: Top-performing CRs get an exclusive opportunity to visit IIT Bombay, experience the campus and witness Aakaar firsthand!
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Open to all engineering students currently enrolled in colleges across India.
 No prior experience or specific prerequisites are required.
 All you need is enthusiasm, dedication and a willingness to take initiative!
 Selection Process 
 Registration: Complete your registration for the Aakaar College Representative Internship. Registration on the official Aakaar CR Portal is also compulsory for all applicants.
 Introductory Session: Attend the introductory session to understand the internship, responsibilities and expectations.
 Confirmation: Selected candidates will receive a confirmation email with further details.
 Internship Format 
 Mode: Remote
 The internship allows you to represent Aakaar and carry out your responsibilities from your respective college, making it accessible to students across India.

unstop-1819896.body:
About Us 
 At MeritixLabs, we are building a next-generation platform for creating and orchestrating autonomous, multi-agent AI systems. Our mission is to replicate and augment the best decision-making processes for enterprises, moving beyond simple chatbots to create agents that are capable of complex, deterministic reasoning and action. These agents don't just chat—they execute workflows, call external APIs, reason over knowledge graphs, coordinate with each other, and resolve customer issues end-to-end. 
 We are a team of engineers, researchers, and AI enthusiasts passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with agentic AI. We are looking for a talented AI Engineer to join us in designing, building, and deploying the intelligent agents that sit at the heart of our platform. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Agent Architecture & Development: Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and CrewAI. You will be responsible for agent state management, tool calling, memory, and multi-turn reasoning. 
 Workflow Orchestration: Build complex, deterministic agentic workflows using LangGraph's state machines and CrewAI's role-based agent teams. Implement robust error handling, retries, and human-in-the-loop patterns. 
 MCP Client Integration: Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients that enable agents to discover, connect to, and invoke tools and resources exposed by MCP servers (built by our platform team). This includes handling resource discovery, tool calling, and prompt retrieval. 
 Knowledge Graph Integration: Design and implement a semantic layer that connects agents to our graph databases (Neo4j, ArcadeDB, or NebulaGraph). Enable agents to query, traverse, and update knowledge graphs to support reasoning and decision-making. 
 Semantic & Vector Memory: Integrate vector databases (Weaviate, ChromaDB) to provide agents with long-term memory, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities. 
 LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Manage interactions with various LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models). Design effective prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, and few-shot examples to maximize agent performance. 
 Tool & API Development: Build tools and connectors that allow agents to interact with external systems—internal APIs, third-party services, databases, and more. Ensure tools are robust, secure, and well-documented. Where appropriate, wrap these tools as MCP-compliant resources. 
 Evaluation & Testing: Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, accuracy, and safety. Develop test suites to catch regressions and edge cases in agent behavior. 
 Observability & Debugging: Build instrumentation to trace agent reasoning steps, log decisions, and monitor performance. Use observability tools (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry) to debug complex agent failures and improve system reliability. 
 Research & Innovation: Stay current with the latest advancements in agentic AI, LLMs, reasoning techniques, and the evolving MCP specification. Rapidly prototype new ideas and bring successful ones to production. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (graduating in 2028 or 2027 preferred). 
 Programming Language: Expert proficiency in Python. Experience with asynchronous programming and API development. 
 Agent Frameworks: Deep experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and/or CrewAI. You should understand their internals and trade-offs. 
 MCP (Model Context Protocol): Strong understanding of the MCP specification. Experience building MCP clients and integrating them into agent workflows. Familiarity with resource discovery, tool calling, and prompt handling is essential. 
 Orchestration & State Management: Strong understanding of state machines, DAGs, and workflow orchestration. Experience with Temporal or Cadence is a plus. 
 Databases: Strong experience with vector databases (Weaviate, ChromaDB, Pinecone, or similar). Experience with graph databases (Neo4j, ArcadeDB, NebulaGraph) is highly preferred. 
 Semantic & Knowledge Engineering: Experience building knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or ontologies. Understanding of RDF, SPARQL, or Cypher is a plus. 
 LLMs & Prompting: Deep understanding of LLM capabilities, limitations, and prompting techniques. Experience with multiple model providers and fine-tuning is a plus. 
 Systems Thinking: Ability to design robust, production-grade systems that handle failure gracefully and scale effectively. 
 Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain complex AI concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 Preferred Skills & Qualifications 
 MCP Server Development: Experience building MCP servers (not just clients) is a

amazon-10593336.body:
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for
‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple
geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight
from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case
of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on
the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with
understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process
changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and
significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation
and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion. 
Key job responsibilities
Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers
(Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data
management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams
who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that
make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the
relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and
identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative
outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review
forum.
Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environmen
- - Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent - Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL - Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments - 10+ 2 degree
- - Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers - Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL
