unstop-1821424.body:
The First Job Reality Check 2026
 Are You Ready to Get Hired?
 Thousands of students graduate every year. But how many are truly ready for their first job? 
 You've attended classes, completed assignments, earned your degree, and perhaps even built a resume.
 But here's the question that matters:
 If you had a job interview tomorrow, would you know how to stand out? 
 Welcome to The First Job Reality Check 2026 , a national-level career-readiness challenge presented by Elevate Careers India .
 This isn't another academic quiz. It's an opportunity to test how you think, make decisions, and approach real-world situations that fresh graduates encounter while preparing for their first job.
 What's the Challenge?
 A 10-question, scenario-based challenge designed to test your practical career readiness across four important areas:
 Career Direction: How clearly do you understand your career choices?
 Profile Strength: Can you demonstrate your skills and position yourself effectively?
 Interview Readiness: How would you handle realistic interview situations?
 Job Search Strategy: Do you know how to approach opportunities and improve your chances?
 Every question encourages you to think beyond textbooks and apply practical judgment.
 Why Should You Participate?
 Because having a degree and being job-ready aren't always the same thing.
 This challenge will help you:
 Test your career readiness through realistic situations.
 Identify areas where your approach might need improvement.
 Challenge common misconceptions about getting hired.
 Reflect on how prepared you are for your first professional opportunity.
 Take an informed next step toward your career goals.
 Challenge Details
 Format: Online, scenario-based multiple-choice quiz
 Questions: 10
 Estimated Duration: 10 minutes
 Participation: Individual
 Registration Fee: FREE
 Mode: Online via Unstop
 Who Can Participate?
 Final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students
 Recent graduates
 Freshers preparing for their first job
 Students from any academic discipline
 No previous work experience is required.
 Are You Really Job-Ready?
 You may have the qualifications.
 You may have the ambition.
 But do you have the readiness to turn an opportunity into your first job?
 10 Questions. Real-World Scenarios. One Reality Check. 
 Take the challenge and discover how prepared you really are.
 Register Now — It's Completely Free! 
 Organized by Elevate Careers India — Helping students move from education to career readiness. 
 Important: This is an educational career-readiness challenge. Participation does not guarantee employment, interviews, internships, or placement opportunities.

 This is a full-time, in-office opportunity based in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with an annual salary range of ₹5,00,000 to ₹5,50,000.

unstop-1822005.body:
Company:  EXIITO BEVERAGES PRIVATE LIMITED
 Department:  Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)
 Experience:  2–4 Years
 Qualification:  Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Food Technology, Chemistry, Microbiology, Food Science, or a related discipline
 Industry:  FMCG – Food & Beverages
 Location:  Surat, Gujarat
 Job Type:  Full-time | On-site
 About the Company 
 EXIITO BEVERAGES PRIVATE LIMITED is a beverage manufacturing company specializing in high-quality, non-carbonated beverages, including fruit juices, premium green tea, and aromatic coffee. The company focuses on natural ingredients, innovative beverage formulations, product quality, and customer satisfaction.
 With a commitment to health, well-being, and sustainable production practices, EXIITO aims to deliver consistent, safe, and high-quality beverages to its customers.
 We are looking for a detail: 
 Oriented d and experienced QA/QC Executive to ensure the quality, safety, and consistency of our beverage products. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring production processes, conducting raw material inspections, in-process quality checks, finished product testing, laboratory analysis, and maintaining quality documentation.
 The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of food and beverage quality standards, quality management systems, food safety regulations, and laboratory testing procedures. The role also involves coordinating with Production and R&D teams to resolve quality issues and support continuous improvement initiatives.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Inspect and test incoming raw materials, ingredients, and packaging materials as per approved quality specifications.
 Perform in-process quality checks during beverage manufacturing to ensure product quality and consistency.
 Conduct laboratory testing, including pH, Brix, TSS, acidity, and other relevant quality parameters.
 Monitor finished products for taste, color, aroma, appearance, and other sensory parameters.
 Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations, GMP, GHP, HACCP, and company quality standards.
 Maintain quality records, laboratory reports, inspection reports, batch records, and test results.

unstop-1822175.body:
Program Expansion & Management: 
 Lead the expansion of the Bal Shiksha Ahara Program to additional schools within Mumbai, ensuring that more children benefit from nutritious meals. 
 Develop and implement strategies to increase meal coverage and participation, focusing on scaling the program while maintaining high-quality service. 
 Work directly with school management and local authorities to integrate meal distribution seamlessly into daily school routines. 
 Stakeholder Engagement: 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with municipal school principals, teachers, and local education authorities. 
 Coordinate with government stakeholders and community organizations to enhance the program’s impact and reach. 
 Foster relationships with donors, partners, and stakeholders ensuring they are regularly updated on the program’s progress and impact. 
 Program Coordination: 
 Oversee the logistical aspects of meal distribution, ensuring that meals are delivered on time and in proper quantities to schools. 
 Manage the supply chain for food procurement, ensuring nutritional standards, quality, and hygiene are maintained. 
 Ensure program staff and volunteers are well-trained and equipped to deliver meals efficiently and safely to children. 
 Monitoring, Reporting & Evaluation: 
 Track and monitor the daily operations of the program, ensuring consistent quality and timely delivery of meals. 
 Collect data on program outcomes (e.g., student attendance, participation) and generate regular reports for internal teams, donors, and external stakeholders. 
 Use feedback from schools, students, and stakeholders to assess the impact of the program and identify areas for improvement. 
 Donor & Community Engagement: 
 Regularly update donors and sponsors on the program’s progress, including success stories, challenges, and key impact metrics. 
 Organize donor visits and community engagement activities to showcase the positive impact of the Bal Shiksha Ahara Program. 
 Team & Volunteer Management: 
 Oversee the recruitment, training, and ongoing support of field staff, volunteers, and on-site teams at the schools. 
 Ensure all staff adhere to program guidelines and maintain a positive, supportive environment for students and their families. 
 Health, Safety & Hygiene Standards: - Regularly assess the health and safety practices in schools, working with local authorities to address any concerns related to food security, sanitation, or student welfare. QUALIFICATIONS Educational and Experience 
 Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Public Health, Education, Business Administration, or a related field. 
 Minimum of 0-3 years of experience in managing community-based programs, especially in food security, education, or health. 
 Previous experience working with schools, government departments, or non-profits is highly desirable. 
 Skills & Competencies: 
 Strong organizational, leadership, and problem-solving skills. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. 
 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
 Experience working with diverse stakeholders, including government bodies, educational institutions, and community members.

unstop-1822092.body:
Rinnit (rinnit.com) publishes free health articles reviewed by a doctor and sells ready-to-edit design templates. We're looking for medical and health students, graduates and health professionals, and health content creators who want to practise explaining health topics clearly to the public.
 What you'll do: 
 Share Rinnit's published health articles and free resources with your classmates and followers.
 Make short videos that summarise or react to a Rinnit article, in your own voice. AI-made videos aren't accepted.
 Only share what Rinnit has published. Please don't give medical advice of your own under the Rinnit name.
 What you'll learn: health communication for the public, content creation and basic digital marketing, with feedback from a practising physician.
 What you get: 
 A free Rinnit digital product when you join, plus a personal discount code for your friends.
 Points for every post and video. At 200 points you get a certificate and a second free product.
 At 600 points you get a reference letter, a LinkedIn recommendation and a feature on Rinnit's channels.
 At 1,500 points you earn 20% commission on sales made with your code, plus an invitation to join a Rinnit Research study.
 How to join: 
 After you're selected, we'll send you a link to complete a short sign-up at rinnit.com/ambassadors, where you'll get your welcome code straight away.
 Time: It's flexible, about a few hours a week. One post or one video counts for points each day.
 Commission payout: We pay commission by PayPal once a month, once your balance reaches $20.
 This is an unpaid, flexible role. Commission is only available at the top level.

unstop-1822710.body:
Overview 
 Caliper Lab is an AI research and data firm. We work with consulting firms and investors. We publish research and data on what AI can do, and what that means for work.
 We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our research and data work. You will work with research literature, company filings, reports and analysis, and with the datasets we build from them. You should be comfortable reading carefully, working with data accurately, and holding a high standard for quality.
 What You Will Do 
 Read research papers, filings, reports and analysis, and pull out what matters. 
 Gather, organise and work with data from public sources, research databases and internal files. 
 Build and update clear, accurate datasets and workbooks in Excel or Google Sheets. 
 Support research requests and help prepare tables, charts and supporting material. 
 Who We Are Looking For 
 2 to 3 years in a KPO, research, data or financial research firm, such as Evalueserve, CRISIL, Acuity, Moody's, S&P, Morningstar, PitchBook, Tracxn, Venture Intelligence, or a Big 4 research team. 
 Comfortable reading research literature, papers, filings and analysis. 
 Strong written English, and fluency in Excel or Google Sheets. 
 High standards, and the judgement to notice when something in a source or dataset does not add up. 
 Strong freshers with an economics, commerce or CA background may be considered if they do very well on the test. 
 Nice to Have 
 SQL or Python, Power BI or Tableau, Capital IQ, Bloomberg, Refinitiv, PitchBook or Factiva, and VBA or Power Query.
 Role Details 
 The role is a 3-month contract, extendable, full-time, and remote in India. Pay is INR 30,000 to 40,000 a month depending on experience, through Deel as a contractor. Start within 2 weeks, with a target of Monday 7 December 2026. Shortlisted applicants complete a short test of up to 2 hours. Applicants with a notice period over 15 days will not be considered.

unstop-1823423.body:
RBP Finivis Pvt Ltd is hiring a Zoho Administrator Intern to own, run, and improve the company's Zoho One setup, with Zoho CRM as the core system. 
 About RBP Finivis: 
 RBP Finivis Pvt. Ltd. is a fintech infrastructure and technology company building solutions that simplify financial operations and enable businesses to launch and scale fintech products. Our technology ecosystem includes white-label fintech platforms, API-driven financial infrastructure, payment integrations, multi-currency solutions and AI-powered business automation.
 Position Overview: 
 Job title: Zoho Administrator Intern
 Company: RBP Finivis Pvt Ltd
 Department: Operations / Technology
 Reports to: Management
 Works closely with: Sales and Marketing, Operations, Compliance, HR and external integration partners
 Employment type: Full-time
 Open positions: 1
 Location: Remote
 Primary platform: Zoho One (Zoho CRM as the main application)
 About the Role: 
 The Zoho Administrator owns the company's Zoho environment. The role keeps every team working in one clean, reliable system, tracking each lead, client, and task from first contact through onboarding.
 The administrator designs and maintains sales pipelines, automations, user access and reports in Zoho CRM. They also manage the wider Zoho One suite, including Zoho People, Projects, Forms, Analytics, Desk and Bookings, and the integrations that connect Zoho to outside platforms.
 The role suits an experienced Zoho professional who can work independently, translate business needs into a working setup, and keep the system secure and well documented.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Zoho CRM administration (primary focus):
 Design, build and maintain modules, layouts, fields, validation rules and page rules for Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals and custom modules.
 Set up and manage sales pipelines and stages for each product line, and keep them aligned with how the business actually sells.
 Build and maintain Blueprints so that leads and deals move through the agreed stages without skipping steps.
 Create assignment rules (including round-robin), so every new lead is given an owner straight away.
 Automate follow-ups with workflow rules, scheduled actions, tasks, reminders and alerts, so no lead is left without a next action.
 Write and maintain custom functions in Deluge where standard automation is not enough.
 Manage lead conversion from Leads to Contacts, Accounts and Deals in line with the agreed sales process.
 Keep data clean: remove duplicates, fill missing details, fix incorrect values and run regular data quality checks.
 Handle data imports, exports and bulk updates safely.
 Zoho One and other applications: 
 Administer Zoho One: users, licences, departments, roles and application access.
 Manage Zoho People: employee records, departments, designations, reporting managers, HR processes, attendance and time logs.
 Manage Zoho Projects: projects, task lists, users, permissions and time tracking.
 Build and maintain Zoho Forms and connect submissions to CRM, Projects and other applications.
 Build reports and dashboards in Zoho CRM and Zoho Analytics.
 Support Zoho Bookings, Zoho Desk, Zoho Cliq, WorkDrive and other Zoho applications as the business adopts them.
 Integrations and APIs: 
 Configure and maintain integrations between Zoho and external platforms (for example, AI sales agents, WhatsApp providers, telephony and payment tools).
 Manage API access through Self Clients and OAuth, including scopes, tokens and dedicated integration users with limited permissions.
 Work with external vendors and integration partners on field mapping, sync rules and testing.
 Monitor integrations and fix sync errors quickly.
 Security, access and compliance 
 Apply least-privilege access: the right profile, role and data sharing for every user.
 Manage user onboarding and offboarding, including licence reallocation when people join or leave.
 Control sensitive permissions such as delete, export and mass update.
 Maintain consent fields, opt-outs and audit trails in line with data protection rules.
 Handle credentials securely, using one-time secure links and never sharing passwords or keys in chat or email.
 Environments and change management 
 Build and test every major change in the Zoho sandbox before moving it to the live system.
 Plan releases so that live users and integrations are not disrupted.
 Keep a change log and roll back quickly if something goes wrong.
 Reporting, training and support 
 Build dashboards for management, sales teams, operations and individual products.
 Schedule daily and weekly reports for management.
 Train users on the CRM process and new features, and write simple guides.
 Act as first-line support for all Zoho questions and issues.
 Manage subscriptions and renewals with the account owner so that no service lapses.
 How the Role Works: 
 The administrator owns the Zoho system end to end. Teams bring their needs; the administrator turns them into a tested, documented

About the Company 
 Inslit is an early-stage, pre-revenue startup developing a digital platform with a focus on UX research.  Test functionality across relevant devices and browsers, noting unexpected behavior, broken links, layout issues, and usability friction.

 Careful, systematic approach and strong attention to detail.
 Ability to follow website flows, notice inconsistencies, and communicate findings in a concise, organized manner.
 Curiosity about how people use digital products and interest in website functionality and user experience.
 Reliable internet access and ability to work independently in a remote setting.
 Clear written communication and a willingness to learn are valued.

Position Overview: 
 Role: AI & Forward Deployed Engineer Intern
 Company: RBP Finivis Pvt. Ltd.

 Position type: Internship

 Work mode: Remote
 Location: India

 About RBP Finivis: 
 RBP Finivis Pvt. Ltd. is a fintech infrastructure and technology company building solutions that simplify financial operations and enable businesses to launch and scale fintech products. Our technology ecosystem includes white-label fintech platforms, API-driven financial infrastructure, payment integrations, multi-currency solutions and AI-powered business automation.
 About the Role: 
 A Forward Deployed Engineer works where the technology meets the business. Instead of building in isolation, you will work directly with our internal teams and partners to deploy, connect and customise AI agents, automations and integrations so they solve real problems in production.
 You will learn how real fintech systems run: AI sales and support agents, CRM integrations, messaging channels, payment APIs and the cloud infrastructure behind them. This is a hands-on role for students who enjoy building, shipping and seeing their work used.
 Internship Tracks: 
 Track A: AI & Backend – Python, backend development, AI agent integration (LLM APIs, prompts, tools, knowledge bases)
 Track B: Integrations & DevOps – REST APIs and webhooks, n8n workflow automation, deployment, monitoring and DevOps
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Build, deploy and improve AI agents that work with leads and customers across channels such as email, WhatsApp and Telegram.
 Integrate AI agents and internal tools with business systems such as Zoho CRM, messaging platforms and payment APIs.
 Design and maintain workflow automations using n8n and APIs to reduce manual work for sales, operations and compliance teams.
 Deploy services to cloud environments, set up monitoring and logging, and fix issues quickly.
 Work with business teams to understand their needs and turn them into working technical solutions.
 Test integrations end-to-end, document setups clearly and maintain simple runbooks.
 Follow secure practices for API keys, tokens and customer data at all times.
 Required Skills: 
 Programming in Python or JavaScript / Node.js.
 Understanding of REST APIs, JSON and webhooks.
 Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
 Basic understanding of large language models and how to use LLM APIs.
 Basic SQL and data handling.
 Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn quickly.
 Clear communication in English.
 Good to Have: 
 Experience with n8n, Zapier, or Make for workflow automation.
 Docker, Linux and basic cloud deployment (AWS, GCP or Azure).
 Experience with AI agent frameworks, RAG or vector databases.
 Exposure to CRM APIs (for example, Zoho CRM), WhatsApp Business API or Telegram bots.
 Personal or academic projects on GitHub showing practical AI integration.
 Interest in fintech, payments or financial infrastructure.
 Who Can Apply: 
 Students or recent graduates of B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. Computer Science or equivalent.
 Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience, including internships.
 Candidates with GitHub projects and hands-on AI integration work will be preferred.
 What You Will Gain: 
 Hands-on experience deploying AI and automation in a live fintech business.
 Mentorship and close work with the technology and business teams.
 Real projects you can show in your portfolio.
 Internship certificate and LOR upon successful completion.
 Opportunity to be considered for a longer-term role based on performance and business needs.
 Selection Process: 
 Resume screening
 Technical assessment
 Practical assignment
 Interview
 How to Apply: 
 Apply through the RBP Finivis Pvt. Ltd. opportunity on Unstop. Please include a link to your GitHub profile or project work.
 RBP Finivis Pvt. Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer.

unstop-1820502.body:
India AI Open 2026 by AccioJob: Proof, Not Resume
 India AI Open by AccioJob is a free, national AI talent contest for students and early-career engineers. You don't send a resume. You build something real, explain how you built it, and win ₹50,000 for 1st, ₹25,000 for 2nd and ₹15,000 for 3rd, plus more cash prizes and get Job Opportunity of Up-to 50LPA and Interships Up-to 1Lakh/Month.
It is solo, it is online, and it takes you through two rounds: a Test with an AI interview, then a short build with an AI walkthrough. AI tools are allowed. What gets scored is your judgment: where you used AI, why, and whether the result holds up.
 Not just another hackathon: there are no teams, no all-nighters and no pitch decks. Just you, a real problem and proof of how you solve it.
 Who can take part 
 Students in any year and engineers with up to 5 years of tech experience
 Any college, any stream
 Individual participation only
 Free to enter
 Working? Your current employer is never told you took part.
 Choose one of five tracks 
Every track has two levels. Build is for students and engineers with up to 2 years of experience. Scale is for engineers with 2+ years, or anyone who wants a harder problem. You can change your track and level until 11 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Below are the examples of what you will build.
 1. AI Engineer 
 Build: A support agent that answers from store policies and live order data, and hands risky questions to a human. Judged on hidden test questions.
 Scale: Make an unreliable agent reliable with evals and guardrails, at the same cost per reply.
 2. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) 
 Build: Fix 2,000 messy delivery complaints for a logistics client, plus an honest one-page note.
 Scale: One codebase that serves 3 clients.
 3. Software Engineer (Backend) 
 Build: A microservice that spins up a microVM in 500 ms. Hidden tests include duplicate and failure cases.
 Scale: 100 microVMs, concurrent requests and a load test with zero double charges.
 4. Full Stack Developer 
 Build: A clinic booking app with zero double-booked slots, where AI summarises notes.
 Scale: 50 clinics with isolated data, permissions and pages that load under 2 s on 3G.
 5. Data Analyst 
 Find out why a store's sales dropped in March from 12 months of messy data. Deliver 3 charts and 1 recommendation.
 Same challenge at both levels; your level decides which roles open to you.
 Pick your level
 Build: Students and engineers with up to 2 years of experience
 Scale: Engineers with 2+ years, or anyone who wants a harder problem
 You are ranked only against others in your own level. Experience is checked. You can change your track and level until 11 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST.
 How it works 
 Register by 11 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Try the Sample Test to see the format.
 Round 1 (Test + AI interview): 12 to 13 Dec 2026. Camera and mic on, face visible, one screen, no one else in the room.
 Round 1 results: 21 Dec 2026. Qualifiers unlock the Round 2 brief.
 Round 2 (build + AI walkthrough): Build solo from 21 Dec; submissions due 26 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Start a new repo after 21 Dec; your commit history is reviewed. Then record one AI walkthrough of about 15 to 20 minutes.
 Final results: 11 Jan 2027. Roles open the same day; company interviews start from 12 Jan 2027.
 What you get 
 A proof report for every builder: Your score, what was checked and what to fix
 The option to apply to roles after results. Companies see your report only if you apply to them.
 Full-time roles with pay up to ₹50 LPA and internships up to ₹1 lakh a month for top performers.
 Cash prizes: ₹50,000 for 1st, ₹25,000 for 2nd and ₹15,000 for 3rd, plus more cash prizes.
 Rules in short 
 Solo only. No teams, no help from anyone else during either round.
 AI tools are allowed. Explain where and why you used them.
 Round 1: Camera and mic on, face visible, one screen, no one else in the room.
 Round 2: New repo after 21 Dec, commit history reviewed, one walkthrough attempt.
 The official rules page is final on any conflict: https://go.acciojob.com/UEt2UL

unstop-1824468.body:
AFAQ Group is hiring a Customer Support Executive 
 A Customer Support Executive (CSE) acts as the primary frontline link between an organization and its customers, handling inbound and outbound communications to drive satisfaction, loyalty, and brand reputation.
 Responsibilities: 
 Multi-Channel Support: Respond to customer queries, requests, and complaints via phone calls, emails, live chat, and social media channels. 
 Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot product or service problems, process replacements or refunds, and handle billing or delivery escalations. 
 Data Logging: Maintain accurate records of interactions, feedback, and support tickets using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools like Salesforce or Zendesk. 
 Product Guidance: Educate customers on product features, usage guidelines, and company policies. 
 Cross-Selling & Upselling: Identify opportunities to recommend relevant add-ons or upgraded services. 
 Follow-Ups: Contact customers after issue resolution or post-purchase to ensure satisfaction and gather feedback. 
 Requirements: 
 Communication Excellence: Fluent and articulate spoken English with the ability to draft clear, polite, and professional written correspondence. 
 Active Listening: Attentive listener skilled at identifying root customer needs and asking targeted questions to resolve issues efficiently. 
 Patience & De-escalation: Exceptional emotional composure when handling difficult, frustrated, or demanding customer interactions. 
 Problem-Solving & Decision Making: Strong analytical mindset focused on delivering swift, accurate, and effective solutions to customer problems. 
 Technical Literacy: Hands-on proficiency in CRM tools, ticketing systems, and customer support databases.

 Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple tasks and priorities.
 Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.

unstop-1824173.body:
Marketing & Sales — Commercial Real Estate & Coworking 
 Bengaluru
 Full-time
 ₹30,000 a month plus uncapped performance incentive
 Languages required: English, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Hindi — all five.
 About 78flex: 
 78flex is Kinetic Blume’s marketplace for flexible workspace in India. A company tells us what it needs — twelve desks near Indiranagar from January, a meeting room on Thursdays — and we match it to real inventory it can book directly. Operators list their space with us; we earn a commission on what gets booked.
 Where We Actually Are: 
 In Bengaluru we have thirteen live, bookable spaces from ten operators: the west belt around Nagarabhavi, Papareddypalya and the ORR, two in Whitefield, and single spaces in Indiranagar, MG Road, JP Nagar, Hebbal near Manyata, Amrutahalli, Sarjapur–Marathahalli and Hennur. We have nothing in Koramangala, HSR Layout, Residency Road or Jayanagar. Outside Bengaluru we have three spaces in Ahmedabad and nothing listed in Hyderabad or Pune, where a customer enquiry is sourced by hand today.
 We are still pre-revenue. Bookings have been attempted on the platform, but not one has yet produced commission. You would be the first salesperson here, writing the playbook rather than following one — which is why your first month carries no revenue target.
 What You Would Do: 
 Create your own demand. Outbound sequences, LinkedIn, target lists, broker and community networks, startup events, business-park outreach, referral loops. This is the marketing half and it is yours.
 Build what you sell with. The one-pager, the proposal and quote template, the pitch you take into the room.
 Find companies that need space. Startups, growing teams, corporates opening a satellite office.
 Qualify properly. How many people, which locality, what date, what budget, who signs.
 Close the deal with the operator in the room, and make sure we are actually paid.
 Bring in operators where we are short. Koramangala and HSR above all.
 Keep the CRM honest. Your incentive is calculated from it.
 Brief the marketing side. Which localities people ask for, which prices stop a conversation.
 Where This Role Stops: 
 We also have a marketing intern. You own the demand you create by hand — outbound, events, referrals, your sales material. They own the demand that arrives on its own — the website and locality pages, search, Google Ads, Instagram and X, Google Business Profiles, analytics. You brief them; you do not do their job.
 Your First 90 Days: 
 Month 1 — Training and pipeline development. No collection target.
 Month 2 — First revenue month. Collection target ₹50,000.
 Month 3 — Steady state. Collection target ₹1,00,000.
 Month 4 onward — Steady state, subject to review. Collection target ₹1,00,000.
 Targets are revised afterwards based on market potential, conversion rates, lead availability and your own performance. Any change is agreed with you in writing before it applies.
 How You Get Paid: 
 ₹30,000 a month whatever happens, plus a monthly incentive on the eligible net brokerage actually received by 78flex — excluding GST, refunds and third-party pass-through collections.
 Your rate for the month is set by how far you get against that month’s collection target. That rate then applies to what you collected, with company-generated and self-generated leads calculated separately.
 Incentive Rates By Monthly Target Achievement: 
 Below 50% of target — 0% on company-generated leads, 0% on self-generated leads
 50% to 99% — 4% on company-generated, 8% on self-generated
 100% to 149% — 6% on company-generated, 12% on self-generated
 150% to 199% — 8% on company-generated, 15% on self-generated
 200% and above — 10% on company-generated, 20% on self-generated
 Worked Examples Against The ₹1,00,000 Target, All Self-Generated: 
 Collect ₹40,000 — that is 40%, below the threshold — you earn ₹0
 Collect ₹70,000 — that is 70%, so 8% — you earn ₹5,600
 Collect ₹1,00,000 — that is 100%, so 12% — you earn ₹12,000
 Collect ₹1,50,000 — that is 150%, so 15% — you earn ₹22,500
 Collect ₹2,00,000 — that is 200%, so 20% — you earn ₹40,000
 A mixed month: you collect ₹1,20,000 — ₹80,000 self-generated and ₹40,000 from our leads. That is 120% of target, so the rate comes off the 100–149% band: ₹80,000 at 12% plus ₹40,000 at 6%, which is ₹12,000. With salary, ₹42,000 for the month. There is no ceiling.
 To Be Eligible, All Of These Must Hold: 
 The lead was entered into the CRM before it was worked on.
 The source of the lead is documented — that decides which rate applies.
 The brokerage has actually been received by 78flex or Kinetic Blume.
 Cancellation and refund conditions are satisfied. If a deal reverses, the incentive reverses and is deducted from the next payout.
 The claim is verifiable in the CRM and in our financial records.
 Adjustments and payments follow the written policy and applicable labour law. Incentive is paid monthly, with the following month’s salary.
 If you leave, brokerage already collec

 Job Description 
 Ocean One Ship Management is looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive to join our Finance & Accounts team at our Mohali office.

The candidate should be well-versed in day-to-day accounting activities and have a strong understanding of accounting principles and financial documentation.

 Handle day-to-day accounting activities, including journal entries, ledger entries, and general bookkeeping.
 Maintain and update accounting records in Tally.

 Handle TDS calculations, deductions, and timely deposit of TDS.

 Assist in monthly and annual closing activities.
 Coordinate with internal teams and external auditors for accounting-related requirements.

 Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or an equivalent qualification.
 Max 2 years of experience in accounting or a similar role.
 Working knowledge of Tally and accounting software.
 Good understanding of GST, TDS, and applicable statutory compliance.
 Strong knowledge of ledger entries, journal entries, and balance sheet preparation.
 Familiarity with bank reconciliation, trial balance, and financial reporting.
 Good numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
 Proficiency in MS Excel and other MS Office applications.
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate financial records.
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 We are looking for a candidate who is organised, dependable, and capable of managing accounting tasks independently while working effectively with the Finance & Accounts team.
 Candidates with prior corporate accounting experience and a strong understanding of accounting procedures will be preferred.

Company: Aravant Enterprises

Working Hours: 8 Hours/Day, Monday to Saturday

 Aravant Enterprises is an Ahmedabad-based B2B Kraft paper indenting and industrial packaging supply chain firm. We connect vetted Kraft paper mills across Gujarat (Morbi, Bavla, Kadi, Mehsana, and Vapi) directly with corrugated box manufacturers across Ahmedabad (Changodar, Vatva, Odhav, Naroda, Sanand) and Gujarat.
 We are looking for energetic, disciplined B2B Industrial Sales & Supply Chain Interns based in Ahmedabad to manage outbound factory outreach, collect regular paper specifications, share daily mill rate quotes, and coordinate end-to-end dispatch execution. Full industry and technical training (GSM, Burst Factor, Reel Deckle sizing, and negotiation scripts) will be provided from Day 1.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Outbound B2B Prospecting: Make structured outbound calls daily in Gujarati and Hindi to corrugated box manufacturers and packaging plants across Ahmedabad and Gujarat.
 Requirement & Spec Discovery: Pitch Aravant Enterprises as a reliable mill-direct backup supplier and capture each buyer's regular paper requirements (GSM, Burst Factor, reel deckle width, and monthly tonnage).
 WhatsApp Rate Quotes & Follow-Ups: Share daily Kraft paper rate updates via WhatsApp and execute disciplined 4-day follow-up cycles to convert inquiries into trial truckload orders.
 CRM & Pipeline Management: Log every call outcome, factory specification, quote sent, and next follow-up date accurately in our Google Sheet CRM.
 Dispatch & Logistics Coordination: Coordinate smoothly between paper mills, transporters, and buyers during truck loading, Lorry Receipt (LR), and delivery confirmation when orders close.
 Requirements & Eligibility: 
 Location: Must currently reside in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
 Language Proficiency: Strong verbal fluency and confidence in Gujarati and Hindi is mandatory. Fluent English is NOT required. Clear, persuasive phone communication in Gujarati and Hindi is what matters most.
 Education: Final-year students or recent graduates in B.Com, BBA, MBA, or any discipline (freshers with strong communication skills are encouraged to apply).
 Skills & Attitude: Comfortable with daily B2B telecalling, resilient against rejection, eager to learn industrial trading and negotiation, and basic familiarity with WhatsApp and Google Sheets/Excel.

unstop-1824425.body:
Job Details: 
 Position : Back Office Intern
 Work Mode :  On-site only
 Location :  Kharadi, Pune
 Stipend :  ₹12,000 – ₹15,000 per month
 Working Days :  6 days a week, Monday – Saturday
 Weekly Off :  Sunday
 Shift Timing :  9:30 AM – 6:00 PM
 Reports To : Service Manager / Branch Manager
 Role Overview : 
 We are looking for an organised and detail-oriented back office intern to manage the day-to-day administrative work of our car service operations. You will handle paperwork, prepare service estimates and invoices, coordinate insurance claims, maintain accurate records and be a friendly, reliable point of contact for our customers. This is an on-site role where you will work closely with the service advisors, technicians and accounts team.
 Key Responsibilities : 
 Form Filling: 
 Fill and verify job cards, service request forms, insurance claim forms, RTO and warranty forms accurately.
 Ensure customer and vehicle details (registration, chassis/engine number, KM reading) are correct on all forms.
 Collect required signatures and supporting documents from customers before submission.
 Document Preparation : 
 Prepare quotations, delivery notes, gate passes, service reports and customer correspondence.
 Scan, print, photocopy and organise documents for customers, insurers and internal teams.
 Draft routine letters and emails in a clear, professional format.
 Estimates For Car Servicing : 
 Prepare service and repair estimates based on technician inputs, parts price lists and labour charges.
 Share estimates with customers, explain the cost breakdown and obtain approval before work starts.
 Prepare revised estimates for additional jobs found during servicing.
 Invoicing & Billing : 
 Generate accurate invoices for parts, labour and consumables with correct GST.
 Match final bills with approved estimates and job cards; resolve differences before delivery.
 Record cash, UPI, card and insurance payments; follow up on pending dues and share daily billing summaries with accounts.
 Insurance Procedure : 
 Coordinate with insurance companies and surveyors for claim intimation, survey and approval.
 Collect and submit claim documents (policy copy, RC, driving licence, claim form, photographs, estimates, FIR if needed).
 Track claim status, handle cashless and reimbursement processes and explain customer liability (depreciation, excess) clearly.
 Record Keeping : 
 Maintain up-to-date records of vehicles serviced, job cards, estimates, invoices and insurance files.
 Keep both physical files and computer records (Excel / billing software) organised and easy to retrieve.
 Maintain service history to support reminders for next service, warranty and insurance renewal.
 Customer Engagement : 
 Greet walk-in customers and handle phone calls, WhatsApp messages and emails politely.
 Update customers on vehicle status, estimate approvals, delivery timelines and claim progress.
 Send service reminders, collect feedback and help resolve complaints in coordination with the service team.
 Dealing & Coordination : 
 Coordinate with parts vendors, suppliers and insurance agents for quotes, orders and follow-ups.
 Support negotiation of parts pricing and delivery timelines as directed by the manager.
 Act as the link between customers, technicians, service advisors and the accounts team.
 Skills & Qualifications : 
 Graduate in any discipline (B.Com / BBA preferred); 12th pass with relevant experience may also apply.
 0–2 years of experience in back office, billing or administration; automobile workshop / dealership experience is a plus.
 Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, email and billing software; basic understanding of GST invoicing.
 Familiarity with motor insurance claim procedures is preferred.
 Good communication in Hindi and English (local language is an advantage).
 Accuracy, attention to detail, good organisation and a customer-friendly attitude.

Your work directly supports the training and validation of machine learning models for Amazon Robotics and Fulfillment Technologies, ensuring the quality and integrity of data which is critical for frontier AI improvements. Your work will involve analyzing processes such as packaging innovation, object manipulation, inventory storage, and sortation automation within fulfillment environments. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to make sound judgments using provided resources, and contributes to maintaining fulfillment center quality metrics through precise text/video/image annotation.  
Key job responsibilities
This is a non-technical, operational role that requires adhering to process oriented, not programming skills. The Associate will perform precise annotation tasks, adhering to goals for accuracy (quality) and speed (productivity). The candidate is expected to demonstrate:  
 Perform precise and consistent annotations across multiple data types (image, video, and text). This includes mastering techniques like object detection, semantic segmentation (pixel-level labeling), object tracking in video, and open-text evaluation.  
 Proactively identify and correct errors, ensuring high data integrity and making obsessive precision crucial for model training.  
 Leverage strong judgment to address ambiguous situations and, when guidelines fail, propose logical, consistent solutions that contribute to process improvement.  
 Quickly learn and efficiently utilize various specialized annotation tools and platforms, adapting to new methodologies as required by evolving programs in domains like packaging, manipulation, storage, and sortation automation.  
 Ability to scale and transition between multiple programs based on business needs 
 This is a contract position with the potential to transition to a full-time employee role based on business needs.   
A day in the life
We are looking for a  Associate, ML Data Operations to undertake the task of foundational labelling functions, such as dialogue evaluation on speech, text, audio, and video data. Associates work in a 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working from home (VCC) with a 9-hour shift and with adequate network coverage typically with a reliable ISP (internet >=20 MBPS speed or higher as communicated from time to time) connection, either through DSL or a cable modem. The shift and break timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case an associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable to Amazon’s work policy.  
Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee  
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive days off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.  
Training Program: Selected candidates will participate in a structured one-week training program to develop essential capabilities and to ensure operational readiness prior to deployment  
About the team
Basic qualifications

 Excellent organizational and time management skills to prioritize complex tasks effectively.

 Show willingness to quickly adapt to new annotation methodologies and learn to use various specialized annotation tools  
 Good communication skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas and provide clear explanations.

Preferred qualifications

amazon-10611170.body:
The L3 Vigil Auditor reviews live and recorded CCTV footage across all five audit workstreams, INTACT, Vision Ops Excellence, RCP, Safety, and Pristine, and across the three miles of IN Operations, and owns the accuracy and coverage of the audits produced. The role takes the audit call on complex and exception cases, drawing on deep working knowledge of the package lifecycle flow, the safety standards audited, the layout of each site, and the CCTV camera nomenclature across the network. The role carries the capability to build automations and real time analytics that advance the audit process, handles confidential video footage under strict data privacy obligations, and operates from a secure, restricted access environment. This is a senior individual contributor role for a candidate with the judgment to resolve ambiguity in process audits without supervision.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
1. Own the audit quality and coverage across all five workstreams and three miles, reviewing live and recorded CCTV footage and taking the final audit call where the finding is complex or sits outside the standard scenarios.
2. Resolve exception and ambiguous cases, applying judgment on process interpretation, camera angle, and footage evidence to reach a defensible finding.
3. Carry working knowledge of the package lifecycle flow through each site, from receive through stow, pick, pack, and ship, so that the footage is read against the correct process step for the area under audit.
4. Understand the layout of every site across the network and the CCTV camera nomenclature and positioning, so that the correct camera for a given location and time is located and reviewed quickly for any workstream or mile.
5. Apply the safety standards audited under the Safety workstream, reading footage against the defined safe practice for the area so that process gaps and unsafe handling are identified accurately.
6. Review audit trends across sites and workstreams, identify the recurring process gaps, and compile the findings for site and program leadership.
7. Follow the step by step checks defined for each audit question, maintain accuracy of findings against the audit standard, and take part in the quality review sessions that check and improve audit accuracy.
8. Meet the audit throughput and accuracy standards set for the role, drive the corrective action cadence with the Ops POCs to closure within the defined timelines, and follow the data privacy and camera access rules at all times, accessing systems only from within the secure environment.
A day in the life
You start your shift by logging into the audit systems from the secure command center and reviewing the audits assigned across the workstreams for the day. You pick up the complex and exception cases first, where the process call is not straightforward, and use your knowledge of the camera nomenclature to open the right camera in Bosch or Milestone for the exact location and time. You read the footage against the package lifecycle flow for that area, from receive through to ship, and against the safety standard where the audit calls for it, to reach a finding you can defend. Through the shift you move across workstreams and miles, from a package handling audit at one FC to a tote handling check at an AMZL site, drawing on your familiarity with how each site is laid out. Where a process gap recurs across sites, you capture it, blur the evidence, and compile it for site leadership with the impact it carries. You spend part of the day advancing an automation that flags a recurring exception for review, so the process relies less on manual checks. You close the shift by confirming the day's audits meet the accuracy bar and the corrective actions are tracked with the sites.
About the team
Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

 The Co
unstop-1825938.body:
AI coding agents are powerful until they hit the same build, dependency, or runtime error for the third session in a row and burn tokens re-debugging it from scratch.
 CoMemor is a fast-growing, local-first Model Context Protocol (MCP) server ( npx comemor , freshly launched v1.1.0) that equips AI coding agents including Cursor, Claude Desktop & Code, VS Code + Copilot, Windsurf, and Google Antigravity with deterministic, repository-scoped engineering memory powered by SHA-256 error fingerprinting, SQLite FTS5 lexical search, automated secret redaction, and prompt-injection quarantine.
 The CoMemor Contributor Challenge invites developers, AI builders, and open-source enthusiasts to ship real production code, sharpen our security and retrieval engine, hunt edge-case bugs, and showcase their engineering work in public. Top contributors earn official certificates and a direct shot at an internship opportunity with the CoMemor team.
 Contribution Tracks (Pick Any or Multiple) 
 Core MCP Engine & Retrieval: Improve TypeScript modules, SQLite FTS5 ranking, error normalization and find_fix / record_failure / verify_fix edge cases.
 Security, Hardening & Testing: Strengthen secret-redaction patterns, prompt-injection heuristics, Vitest unit/integration tests, and retrieval benchmarks.
 Memory Console & Developer Experience: Enhance the local Memory Console UI, IDE setup workflows, cross-platform Windows/macOS/Linux compatibility, and documentation.
 High-Signal Bug Hunting & RFCs: Identify reproducible bugs, security edge cases, or well-scoped architectural feature proposals via GitHub Issues.
 How to Participate (Step-by-Step) 
 Register on Unstop: Complete your individual registration before the deadline.
 Join the WhatsApp Community:  https://chat.whatsapp.com/LSGNBQDsAvwBDiBJVkcUgQ
 Connect with the Project: 
 Star and Watch the CoMemor GitHub repository to track open issues and releases.
 Pick or Propose Work: Browse issues labeled good first issue , help wanted , or contributor-challenge or open a clear, reproducible new issue before coding.
 Ship Quality Contributions: Fork the repo, follow Contributing.md , ensure tests pass locally, and open a well-documented Pull Request.
 Showcase Your Work on LinkedIn (Required for Leaderboard Scoring): After submitting your PR or verified issue, publish a short video demo (30–90 seconds) or a concise technical article/post on LinkedIn explaining the problem you solved and what you added or fixed in CoMemor. Tag the CoMemor LinkedIn page and include the hashtags #comemor , #comemorcontributor , #opensource , and #mcp .
 Submit Proof on Unstop: Submit your GitHub username, PR/Issue links, and LinkedIn post link during the submission window.
 Format & Rounds 
 Round 1: Registration & Repo Onboarding: Register on Unstop, star & watch the repository, follow CoMemor on LinkedIn, set up the project locally and claim or open your first issue.
 Round 2: Contribution & Build-in-Public Sprint: Submit Pull Requests and/or high-impact issues, respond to maintainer reviews, and publish your LinkedIn demo video or walkthrough post.
 Round 3: Maintainer Review & Results: Final scoring of merged/accepted contributions, leaderboard announcement, certificate distribution, and internship interview invites for top contributors.
 Guidelines & Eligibility 
 Eligibility: Open to college students, freshers, and working professionals from all branches and specializations.
 Participation Format: Individual participation only (inter-college / open to all institutions).
 Number of Contributions: Unlimited, you may submit multiple PRs or issues, and every merged/accepted contribution counts toward your final rank.
 Rules & Quality Standards 
 All code and write-ups must be your original work and comply with CoMemor's GPL-3.0 license and CONTRIBUTING.md .
 Use of AI is allowed and it is recommended to mention the specific AI Model or tool used for development.
 Pull Requests must pass repository build and automated test checks (CI) and address a real bug, test gap, feature, or substantive docs improvement.
 Zero Spam Policy: Low-effort PRs (trivial typo/whitespace edits, duplicate issues, or unverified AI-generated code dumps) will be closed and disqualified from certification.
 You must comment on an issue to claim it before opening a PR if someone else is not already assigned.
 Maintainer review and merge decisions are final.
 Evaluation Criteria 
 Technical Depth & Code/Issue Quality (45%): Clean architecture, correctness, and real impact on CoMemor users.
 Testing & Engineering Hygiene (25%): Test coverage, clear PR descriptions, adherence to repo conventions, and zero regressions.
 LinkedIn Demo / Walkthrough Clarity (20%): Clear explanation of why the fix/feature matters and how it works in practice.
 Collaboration & Review Responsiveness (10%): Constructive communication and timely iteration on maintainer feedback.
 Rewards & Perks 
 Top Contributors: Chance to land an Internship Opportunity

The Career Compass Challenge: 
 A National Career Readiness & Future Skills Competition

 About the Challenge: 
 Many students choose a career by default, not by direction.

 Through two engaging quiz rounds participants will explore careers, future skills, business awareness, workplace fundamentals and professional readiness.
 This is an opportunity to test your knowledge, challenge your thinking, receive career guidance and discover your next direction.
 Who Can Participate? 
 Undergraduate and postgraduate students.
 Students from all academic years.
 Students from all streams and disciplines.
 Individual participation only.
 No coding or specialised technical knowledge required.
 Registration Fee: FREE 
 Competition Structure: 
 ROUND 1: TRUE BEARING 
 Date: Sunday, 6 December 2026
Time: 12:00 PM
 An engaging quiz covering:
 Career awareness and career opportunities.
 Emerging job roles and industries.
 Future skills and employability.
 Understanding recruitment and hiring.
 Professional and workplace awareness.
 ROUND 2: INsight OUT 
 Date: Sunday, 13 December 2026
Time: 12:00 PM
 A business and workplace awareness quiz covering:
 Business fundamentals.
 Corporate and workplace scenarios.
 Business awareness and current developments.
 Organisational structures and workplace practices.
 Professional decision-making.
 Rewards & Recognition 
 Everything below is built for your next move, whether that's an internship, placements or the role after.
 Top 3 performers: Internship interview opportunities
 A 60-minute 1:1 session with an expert mentor
 A personalised Career Compass assessment
 An ATS-friendly resume makeover and LinkedIn profile guidance
 Interview preparation and Placement Navigator support
 Letters of Recommendation for eligible candidates
 Access to an exclusive live masterclass
 Certificates of recognition
 Together, these rewards are worth ₹40,000+.
 Find Your North. Own Your Direction. 
 Why Participate? 
 Understand emerging career opportunities.
 Test your awareness of business and workplace fundamentals.
 Evaluate your professional readiness.
 Receive personalised career guidance.
 Explore potential internship opportunities.
 Access a minimum 50% discount on the rewards
 Earn recognition for your performance.
 ABOUT THE ORGANISER – THE NORTH AXIS 
 The North Axis, operated by TNA Careers Private Limited, is a School Partnerships and Student Development Organisation working with schools to nurture confident, capable and future-ready students.
 Our key offerings include:
 Career Compass™ – Career assessments and personalised career guidance.
 PRISM 7D™ – Our proprietary psychometric testing tool designed to assess key dimensions of an individual's profile and support informed career and personal development.
 DISCOVER 7D™ – A holistic student development programme covering seven dimensions of growth.
 CLUBs – Instructor-led extracurricular and skill-development programmes.
 EVENTs – Competitions, championships, workshops and experiential learning opportunities.
 EDGE – Expert-Driven Guidance & Education , an expert-curated academic learning and resource hub offering subject-specific study materials, educational resources, examination preparation and academic guidance for students and educational partners.
 The North Axis – Direction. Action. Success. 
 Find Your North 2026 is an initiative to make career awareness, professional readiness and meaningful career guidance accessible to college students across India.
 IMPORTANT INFORMATION
 Registration is free.
 Participation is individual.
 Participants must follow the published competition schedule.
 Only eligible participants will receive participation certificates.
 The Top 15 participants after Round 2 will qualify for the Grand Finale.
 Internship interview opportunities can be extended or reduced on the organizer's discretion depending on the total number of participants.
 Career sessions will be delivered through The North Axis's available 1:1 service offerings through unstop.
 The North Axis reserves the right to verify results and determine final award eligibility.
 FIND YOUR DIRECTION. TEST YOUR READINESS. DISCOVER YOUR NORTH.
 Find Your North 2026 – The Career Compass Challenge 
 Direction. Action. Success. 
 Organised by The North Axis

unstop-1822093.body:
About AskGalore 
 AskGalore Digital is an AI-driven transformation company building intelligent solutions for enterprise clients. We combine deep technical expertise in AI/ML, modern software development, and design to modernize legacy systems, scale automation across organizations, and solve mission-critical business problems.  
 About the Role 
 At AskGalore we build AI-powered automations that solve real, messy business problems for global clients. This role is a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - you sit between our finance-domain business analysts and the working software, translating real-world process logic into production-grade automations powered by Claude and other LLMs. 
 This is not a model-training, data-science, or MLOps role. It's for a strong full-stack engineer who has learned to build dramatically faster with AI and wants that to be the core of the job, someone who uses AI to the hilt to design, build, test, and ship.If you started your career writing full-stack code and have grown into shipping AI-driven automations and agentic workflows, this role is built for you. 
 What You Will Do 
 Work directly with finance-domain BAs to turn business logic and process rules into automated, end-to-end workflows. 
 Design, build, and deploy complex automations orchestrated with Claude / LLMs — prompt engineering, tool use (function calling), and multi-step agentic workflows. 
 Build the full stack around the AI: APIs, backend services, integrations, and lightweight dashboards. 
 Use AI-powered QA agents to test, validate, and harden what you ship. 
 Integrate automations with client systems — databases, ERPs, third-party APIs, and webhooks. 
 Deploy at the point of use, iterate fast on real feedback, and own outcomes rather than tickets. 
 Write clean, modular, well-documented code with proper version control. 
 You’ll thrive here if you 
 Began in full-stack development and grew into AI-powered building — you now ship 10x faster because AI is part of how you work, not a side experiment. 
 Think like a product engineer: you research, prototype, build, and deploy independently. 
 Are comfortable talking to non-technical domain experts and turning ambiguity into working software. 
 Move fast, take ownership, and care about the result landing with the client. 
 What You Bring 
 Core (Must-Have) 
 A strong full-stack foundation (Python + JavaScript/TypeScript; React/Node or equivalent). 
 Solid backend / API development and systems integration — REST APIs, webhooks, databases, authentication. 
 Hands-on experience building real automations with LLMs (Claude, GPT, or similar): prompt engineering, tool use / function calling, and agentic / multi-step workflows. 
 Fluency with AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot — you build with AI every day. 
 Experience with workflow automation platforms or frameworks (n8n, Temporal, Zapier, Make, or custom orchestration). 
 Clean, production-quality code with documentation and Git-based version control 
 Nice-to-Have 
 Exposure to finance / FinTech domain or process automation. 
 Competitive Programming & Technical Assessments: Candidates are invited to include verifiable credentials, ranks, or assessment scores from recognized platforms—such as LeetCode, CodeSignal, HackerRank, Codeforces, CodeChef, or Kaggle—to demonstrate technical problem-solving proficiency. 
 RAG, vector databases, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool-connected agents. 
 Basic cloud + Docker for deployment. 
 Familiarity with AI-driven testing / QA agents. 
 Note: This role does not require Computer Vision, NLP research, deep learning, or model training. We're looking for builders, not researchers. 
 What we offer 
 A rare chance to be an early, senior AI-automation hire with real influence over how we build. 
 Genuinely interesting problems — you'll ship AI automations that go live with global clients, not demos. 
 Autonomy and ownership from day one, working shoulder-to-shoulder with domain experts and founders. 
 Competitive compensation of ₹12–18 LPA based on experience and demonstrated ability. 
 Required Skill Set 
 Python (FastAPI), LLMs (LangGraph, LangChain, Pydantic), RAG and Vector Databases, AWS and Azure, Vibe coding, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, Docker and Kubernetes, Langfuse/LangSmith for observability.  
 Why This Role 
 Real work, real impact: You'll contribute to systems used by actual clients, not throwaway assignments 
 Steep learning curve: Work directly with experienced engineers and consultants who will mentor you 
 AI-first exposure: Get hands-on with RAG pipelines and agentic workflows — skills that are in high demand 
 Career runway: Strong performers will be considered for full-time AI/ML Engineer roles 
 Startup pace, structured mentorship: Move fast, ask questions, and grow quickly in a supportive team

Role: Graphic Design Intern 
 Company: Dezainahub 
 Duration: 3-6 months + PPO 
 PPO: 3.6 LPA-6 LPA 
 Work Mode: Full-Time, On-Site

 Stipend : ₹5,000 - ₹10,000 / month 
 Eligibility: Graduates & Final-Year Students 
 About Us 
 Dezainahub is one of the leading IT firms in Delhi-NCR, building for brands that hate looking small. We work with growth-focused businesses to build stronger brands, digital experiences, and technology solutions. We bring together Branding, UI/UX, Websites, Apps, Web Applications, Digital Products, Content, and Custom Technology Solutions to help businesses present themselves better, communicate clearly, and grow effectively. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Graphic Designer Intern who wants to go beyond simply making things look pretty and focus on clean layout compositions, modern typography, proper spacing, hierarchy, and visual balance. You will work on real client projects, build digital and print marketing assets, and experiment with brand guidelines across multiple visual treatments. You must be curious enough to figure things out, step outside your comfort zone, accept feedback openly, and test different directions. This is a full-time, in-office internship. Applicants should be fully committed to working from our Saket office throughout the internship period. 
 What You'll Work On 
 Digital Creatives: Create graphics for social media platforms, digital campaigns, banners, and marketing promotions. 
 Brand Assets: Develop brand-related visual assets and build presentations that align with guidelines. 
 Concept Exploration: Turn existing concepts into strong visual stories while exploring different design directions. 
 Visual Testing: Experiment with various layouts, compositions, typography, imagery, and visual styles to create multiple variations. 
 Design Support: Assist the creative team with daily visual requirements, explore new design trends, and work on unique project styles.            
 Feedback Iteration: Actively take creative feedback to refine, edit, and improve designs through multiple versions. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 Educational Background: Currently pursuing a degree/diploma in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts (or a related field)—or simply genuinely passionate about design. 
 Core Design Instinct: A good eye for composition, typography, spacing, hierarchy, and visual balance. 
 Mindset & Ownership: Ability to take constructive feedback without taking it personally, work independently once given clear goals, and stay highly disciplined. 
 Tools & Skills: Practical experience with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma , Canva , or similar creative platforms. 
 We Especially Welcome People Who... 
 Love to experiment! If your reaction to "We've never tried this before" is "Let's try it," rather than "That's not how we were taught," you will fit right in. We value individuals who create beyond their comfort zone, test rather than assume, explore rather than copy, and take immediate initiative instead of waiting for micro-instructions. 
 What You'll Get 
 Live Project Exposure: Real-world experience working on active client work and internal agency projects. 
 Professional Growth: Direct mentoring from an experienced creative team and exposure to the business side of design. 
 Executive Collaboration: Opportunity to work closely with the founding team and build a highly competitive portfolio. 
 Credentials: Certificate of Completion and a performance-based Letter of Recommendation (LOR)

India MUN is hiring for Video Editing Intern 
 Organisation: GAIA The Earth Foundation
 Duration: 3–6 Months
 Stipend: ₹5,000 per month
 Type: Paid Internship
 About GAIA The Earth Foundation 
 GAIA The Earth Foundation is an international non-profit organisation working at the intersection of Youth, Media, Innovation and Regeneration. Recognised as an Actor of the UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration (2021–2030), GAIA works towards enabling nature to regenerate, building sustainable solutions and shaping the next generation of environmental leaders.
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editing Intern to support GAIA's digital media and content production initiatives.
 The intern will be responsible for creating engaging video content for GAIA's social media platforms, campaigns, programmes and events. This role offers an opportunity to work on diverse creative projects, experiment with visual storytelling and contribute to communicating environmental and sustainability initiatives through digital media.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Video Editing & Production 
 Edit engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other digital platforms.
 Create promotional videos, event highlights, interviews, testimonials and campaign videos.
 Transform raw footage into engaging visual stories using appropriate cuts, transitions, subtitles and background music.
 Incorporate motion graphics, text overlays, animations and sound effects.
 Perform basic colour correction, audio enhancement and video optimisation.
 Adapt videos into different formats and aspect ratios for various platforms.
 Organise and manage raw footage, edited videos and project files.
 2. Creative Content & Visual Design 
 Develop creative concepts and ideas for video content.
 Create thumbnails, social media creatives and promotional visuals.
 Assist with basic graphic design using Canva, Photoshop or similar tools.
 Explore creative storytelling techniques and emerging social media trends.
 Maintain consistency with GAIA's visual identity and branding.
 3. Digital Media & Content Support 
 Assist in preparing video content for social media publishing.
 Support the development of visual content for campaigns, programmes and digital promotions.
 Review and refine videos based on feedback to ensure quality and consistency.
 Stay updated on video editing trends, tools and creative formats.
 Skills & Qualifications 
 Proficiency in graphic designing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Final Cut Pro or CapCut.
 Understanding of video editing, storytelling, transitions, pacing and sound design.
 Basic knowledge of motion graphics, animation and colour grading.
 Familiarity with Canva, Photoshop or other graphic design tools.
 Understanding of Instagram, YouTube and other digital content formats.
 Creativity, visualisation skills and attention to detail.
 Ability to work independently, incorporate feedback and meet deadlines.
 Who Can Apply? 
 Undergraduate and postgraduate students or recent graduates from any discipline.
 Individuals interested in video editing, filmmaking, digital media and visual storytelling.
 Candidates with previous editing projects, a portfolio or showreel will have an advantage.
 Creative individuals who enjoy experimenting with different styles and formats.
 What We Offer? 
 Monthly Stipend : ₹5,000 for the duration of the internship.
 Experience Letter : Official experience letter upon successful completion.
 Professional Portfolio : Opportunity to work on real-world creative projects and build a strong portfolio.
 Creative Freedom : Scope to experiment with different video formats, storytelling styles and creative ideas.
 Industry Exposure : Work on campaigns and initiatives with national and international visibility.
 Mentorship : Guidance and feedback from the team to strengthen your creative and technical skills.
 Networking: Exposure to professionals and organisations working across sustainability, media and innovation.
 Career Development: Practical experience in digital media, video production and creative communications.
 For queries: munofindia@gmail.com

SpiralInfra is hiring for the role of UI/UX Designer Intern! 
 About the Company: 
 Spiral Infra is an early-stage technology venture focused on building practical, AI-powered products that solve real-world problems. We are currently building products at the intersection of technology, artificial intelligence, education, and user experience.
 Our flagship product, CogniBloom , is an AI-powered learning platform designed to help learners develop genuine understanding rather than simply receive answers.
 Join us if you want to build, experiment, learn, and contribute to a real product from the ground up.
 About the Role: 
 Spiral Infra is looking for a creative and product-minded UI/UX Designer Intern to join our product team and contribute to the design and evolution of CogniBloom , our AI-powered learning platform.
 You will work closely with the product and development teams to design intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly experiences for learners.
 This role is ideal for someone who wants to understand how real digital products are designed, rather than simply creating standalone visual designs.
 What You Will Work On 
 Design and improve user interfaces for CogniBloom's web experience.
 Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
 Translate product requirements into intuitive user experiences.
 Work on dashboards, learning experiences, onboarding flows, and interactive AI-powered features.
 Conduct basic user research and identify usability problems.
 Analyze user feedback and convert insights into design improvements.
 Maintain consistency across the product's visual design system.
 Collaborate closely with developers to ensure designs are practical and accurately implemented.
 Participate in product discussions and contribute ideas beyond visual design.
 Help establish reusable UI components and design patterns.
 What We Are Looking For 
 Good understanding of UI/UX principles.
 Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools.
 Understanding of typography, spacing, layouts, color, and visual hierarchy.
 Ability to create clean and modern interfaces.
 Basic understanding of responsive web design.
 Understanding of user flows and interaction design.
 Strong attention to detail.
 Willingness to receive feedback and iterate.
 Interest in AI products, EdTech, SaaS, or consumer technology is a plus.
 Good to Have 
 Experience designing web applications.
 Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS.
 Experience creating prototypes in Figma.
 Understanding of design systems.
 Previous experience working on a real-world product or startup project.
 A portfolio or previous design work.
 What You Will Gain 
 Hands-on experience designing a real AI-powered product.
 Experience working with a product and engineering team.
 Exposure to the complete product design lifecycle.
 Experience designing for real users rather than only academic projects.
 Understanding of how design decisions affect product usability and engagement.
 Practical experience working in an early-stage startup environment.
 Opportunity to build strong portfolio projects.
 Who Should Apply? 
 Students, freshers, self-taught designers, and aspiring product designers who are genuinely interested in building digital products and want practical experience.
 A strong portfolio is preferred, but we are also open to candidates who can demonstrate good design thinking through personal or academic projects.
 Important Information 
 This is a 3-month unpaid internship .
 The internship is completely remote .
 Candidates are expected to be proactive, responsible, and able to manage their work independently.
 Selected candidates will work directly on Spiral Infra's product initiatives, primarily CogniBloom.

Data Analyst Internship – Roles, Responsibilities, Skills & Requirements 
 Are you looking to start your career in data analytics? A Data Analyst Internship is an excellent opportunity for students, fresh graduates, and aspiring data professionals to gain practical experience in data analysis, data visualization, and business intelligence. 
 As a Data Analyst Intern, you will work with real-world datasets, identify trends, prepare reports, and help organizations make data-driven decisions. This internship provides hands-on experience with popular tools such as Microsoft Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau. 
 Data Analyst Internship Roles and Responsibilities: 
 The key roles and responsibilities of a Data Analyst Intern include: 
 Collect, organize, and analyze data from different sources. 
 Clean and preprocess raw data to ensure accuracy and consistency. 
 Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and patterns. 
 Write SQL queries to extract, filter, and manage data. 
 Use Microsoft Excel to perform calculations, create reports, and analyze datasets. 
 Develop interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau. 
 Assist in preparing daily, weekly, and monthly data analysis reports. 
 Use Python libraries such as Pandas and NumPy for data manipulation. 
 Identify business trends and provide meaningful insights. 
 Support senior data analysts with ongoing projects. 
 Maintain proper documentation of data analysis activities. 
 Present analytical findings to team members and management. 
 Data Analyst Internship Requirements: 
 Candidates interested in a Data Analyst Internship should have the following qualifications and skills: 
 Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and data analysis. 
 Understanding of SQL queries and database concepts. 
 Basic knowledge of Python programming is an advantage. 
 Familiarity with Power BI or Tableau for data visualization. 
 Understanding of statistics and analytical concepts. 
 Knowledge of data cleaning and data preprocessing techniques. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 Good communication and presentation skills. 
 Ability to work independently and collaboratively. 
 Willingness to learn new data analytics tools and technologies. 
 Technical Skills Required for a Data Analyst Intern: 
 Microsoft Excel: Formulas, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP
 SQL: SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY
 Python: Pandas, NumPy
 Power BI: Dashboard creation and visualization
 Tableau: Data visualization
 Statistics: Basic statistical concepts
 Data Analytics: Data cleaning and analysis
 Data Visualization: Charts, graphs, and reports
 Benefits of a Data Analyst Internship: 
 A Data Analyst Internship helps candidates develop practical technical and professional skills, including: 
 Hands-on experience working with real-world datasets. 
 Practical knowledge of Excel, SQL, Python, and Power BI. 
 Understanding of business intelligence and data analytics. 
 Experience creating professional dashboards and reports. 
 Improved analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Opportunity to work with experienced data professionals. 
 Preparation for entry-level Data Analyst and Business Analyst roles. 
 Career Opportunities After a Data Analyst Internship: 
 After completing a Data Analyst Internship, candidates can explore several career opportunities: 
 Junior Data Analyst 
 Data Analyst 
 Business Analyst 
 Business Intelligence Analyst 
 Reporting Analyst 
 SQL Analyst 
 Power BI Developer 
 Data Visualization Analyst

 Location: Delhi NCR (Work from Office)
