 About Veltrix 
 Veltrix Global Connect is a DPIIT-recognised, cross-border B2B marketplace for skilled trades. We connect global employers with verified workers from India, Southeast Asia and Africa through licensed recruitment agencies. The hard part isn't that workers or employers are scarce — it's finding genuine, verified agencies who can actually deliver. That's the gap we close. We're an outcome-delivery platform, not a job board, and we're growing fast. 
 What You'll Do 
 We're looking for a curious, creative, and research-driven Marketing & Growth Intern who loves exploring unconventional ways to reach audiences.
 Social Media & Content: Create engaging content for LinkedIn, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.
 SEO & Content Research: Research what our target audiences are searching for and create relevant, search-friendly content, including blogs and articles.
 Community Engagement: Discover and engage with potential audiences across Reddit, Quora, Telegram, Facebook Groups, LinkedIn Groups, and other niche communities.
 Market Research: Research international recruitment markets, industry trends, competitors, and audience behavior to identify growth opportunities.
 Brand Representation: Represent Veltrix Connect in relevant online forums, communities, and industry discussions.
 Growth Experiments: Identify and test unconventional marketing channels to increase brand awareness and reach our target audiences.
 Who We're Looking For 
 Recent graduates or students who can commit to a full-time, in-office internship for at least 3 months .
 Strong research, writing, and communication skills.
 Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing fundamentals.
 Someone who is proactive, resourceful, creative, and comfortable experimenting with new ideas.
 Basic knowledge of SEO, content marketing, Canva, or AI tools is a plus.
 Interest in B2B marketing, startups, or international business is an advantage.
 What We offer 
 A paid internship with hands-on experience in B2B marketing and growth.
 Opportunity to experiment with creative and unconventional marketing strategies.
 Direct exposure to startup founders and international markets.
 Potential internship extension based on performance and business requirements.

amazon-10612403.body:
Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? Amazon is looking for a Process Improvement Specialist to join our EU FBA Support Operations team, where you will identify opportunities to enhance workflows, reduce waste, and drive meaningful results. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners to build and implement solutions that directly impact team performance and the associate experience.
You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.
A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.
Key job responsibilities
• Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
• Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
• Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.
• Monitor system performance and service levels through defined metrics, using findings to refine processes and sustain long-term operational gains.
• Support development and implementation of Automation through data-driven analysis by coordinating with wider organization and tracking progress
• Identify and implement sustainable improvements for operational excellence using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
• Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
• Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
• Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
• Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions
A day in the life
A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their work between identifying process gaps, performing execution support, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods. Additionally, you might start your morning reviewing performance dashboards to spot trends or anomalies in s key metrics. From there, you could spend time on observing a workflow firsthand, gathering input to engage directly with stakeholders, sellers and and manage what is working and what could be better. You might draft a new procedure based on your findings, coordinate with a partner team on an upcoming rollout, or present a recommendation to leadership. You will balance hands-on problem-solving with clear documentation and communication throughout the day.

amazon-10609156.body:
NOC (Network Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting India. It ensures timely tracking procurement and movement between various Amazon hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 
1. Watch CCTV camera recordings from Amazon operations sites and check whether the activities on video follow the correct process, by answering a set of defined audit questions for each site.
2. Use the camera viewing software to find and open the right camera for a given location and time, and look closely at the footage to spot any process gaps or incorrect handling.
3. Complete the number of audits assigned for your shift each day, keeping both speed and accuracy at the expected level.
4. Build familiarity with how each site is laid out, how packages move through it, and how the cameras are named and positioned, so that you can quickly locate the correct footage to review.
5. Record your findings in the audit system, take screenshots as proof wherever a process is not being followed, and save that proof in the right place within the required time.
6. Follow the step by step checks defined for each audit question, and raise anything unclear or unusual to your team lead or manager.
7. Share your audit results on the schedule set for each audit type, whether that is daily, weekly, or once in two weeks.
8. Treat all video footage and findings as confidential, and follow the rules on data privacy and camera access at all times.
9. Take part in the training and practice when you join, including watching experienced auditors at work and then being observed yourself, and learn to handle more than one type of audit.
10. Meet the quality standards set for audit accuracy, and take part in the review sessions that check and improve the quality of audits.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel.
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network.
- Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as access control/intrusion detection and CCTV surveillance systems
- Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities

amazon-10604072.body:
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for
‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple
geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight
from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case
of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on
the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with
understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process
changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and
significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation
and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion. 
Key job responsibilities
Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers
(Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data
management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams
who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that
make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the
relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and
identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative
outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review
forum.
Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environmen
- - Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent - Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL - Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments - 10+ 2 degree
- - Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers - Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL

amazon-10609447.body:
About the Organization: Amazon is a US-based multinational electronic commerce company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Amazon.com started as an online bookstore, but soon diversified into many other categories, with a vision to be earth's most customer-centric company & to build a place where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online.
About the role: Amazon's Global Finance Services (GFS) team is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment and delivering great experiences for our customers is top priority. GFS is seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer to support our Amazon Music finance team.
As a Data Engineer, You will be working on building and maintaining complex data pipelines, assemble large and complex datasets to generate business insights and to enable data driven decision making and support the rapidly growing and dynamic business demand for data.
You will have an opportunity to collaborate and work with various teams of Business analysts, Managers, Business Intelligence, and Data Engineers to determine how best to design, implement and support solutions. You will be challenged and provided with tremendous growth opportunity in a customer facing, fast paced, agile environment.
Key job responsibilities
* Design, implement and support an analytical data platform solutions for data driven decisions and insights
* Design data schema and operate internal data warehouses & SQL/NOSQL database systems
* Work on different data model designs, architecture, implementation, discussions and optimizations
* Interface with other teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of data sources using AWS big data technologies like EMR, RedShift, Elastic Search etc.
* Work on different AWS technologies such as S3, RedShift, Lambda, Glue, etc.. and Explore and learn the latest AWS technologies to provide new capabilities and increase efficiency
* Work on data lake platform and different components in the data lake such as Hadoop, Amazon S3 etc.
* Work on SQL technologies on Hadoop such as Spark, Hive, Impala etc..
* Help continually improve ongoing analysis processes, optimizing or simplifying self-service support for customers
* Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven, and deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment.
* Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.
* Enjoy working closely with your peers in a group of talented engineers and gain knowledge.
* Be enthusiastic about building deep domain knowledge on various Amazon’s business domains.
* Own the development and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions.
- 1+ years of data engineering experience
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
- Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)
- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
- Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.

Volopay is hiring for the role of Customer Success Operations Executive 
 About 
Volopay is a Y Combinator-backed start-up that combines corporate cards, bills payments, approvals, expense reimbursements, and accounting automation in one single platform. We empower businesses to manage, grow and succeed with our cross-platform solution that delivers more functionality across different areas of operations.
 We are backed by some of the top investors in the world, and on our way to being one of the most influential fintech start-ups in Southeast Asia, with ambitions to expand.
 For selling a platform like this, we need people who are super excited about the vision of the company and who are passionately curious about building this for businesses out there.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead onboarding for new clients by assisting in documentation, compliance (KYB & KYC) approval process, and account set-up
 Collaborate with multiple departments such as Product and Sales to ensure a smooth onboarding process
 Prepare and distribute invoices as well as monitor and track billing cycles to ensure timely billing
 Update the client records and ensure data integrity and accuracy
 Should be able to generate basic reports and analyse patterns and trends with the client data
 Proactively improve processes to provide faster delivery
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 Strong ability to work on multiple issues and tasks in a fast-paced environment and should prioritize work according to business processes
 Be flexible in handling different markets based on business requirements.
 Skills & Qualifications 
 Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience are welcome.
 A hustler with a proactive attitude and a strong willingness to learn and take ownership.
 Proficiency in HubSpot, ZohoDesk and Microsoft Excel is a plus!
 Love for reporting, numbers, and speaking to people
 Demonstrate a desire to proactively help and serve internal/external stakeholders to meet their needs
 Should possess high adaptability and be able to work under pressure
 Should be comfortable working independently in a remote work environment.
 Our Culture 
At Volopay, you'll thrive among passionate, talented individuals who bring their energy into everything they do. Our team's diversity is our strength, with musicians, entrepreneurs, athletes, and more contributing their unique talents. Picture a workplace that's not just about work, but about a shared journey. We value your independence and trust you with tasks, encouraging you to take ownership and find innovative solutions. Our culture is rooted in:
 Ownership: We believe in freedom with responsibility. You'll naturally take the lead and excel.
 Results: We're doers who overcome obstacles with a can-do attitude.
 Curiosity: Curious minds thrive here. Wear multiple hats and embrace new challenges.
 Join Volopay for a vibrant, dynamic atmosphere where innovation thrives, and your individuality shines.

unstop-1829169.body:
Job Description – E-commerce Sales Executive 
 Job Title: E-commerce Sales Executive
 Department: Sales / E-commerce
 Experience: 1–3 Years (Freshers with relevant knowledge may also apply)
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Reporting To: E-commerce Manager / Sales Manager
 Job Summary
 We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented E-commerce Sales Executive to manage and grow online sales across various e-commerce marketplaces and digital sales channels. The candidate will be responsible for managing product listings, generating online sales, monitoring marketplace performance, coordinating orders, and ensuring a smooth customer experience.
 Key Responsibilities
 Manage and monitor sales across e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, and other marketplaces.
 Create, update, and optimize product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and keywords.
 Monitor daily sales, orders, returns, cancellations, and inventory levels.
 Develop strategies to increase online sales and achieve monthly sales targets.
 Coordinate with the warehouse and logistics teams for timely order processing and dispatch.
 Monitor competitor pricing, product performance, and market trends.
 Manage promotional campaigns, discounts, deals, and marketplace advertisements.
 Handle customer queries, complaints, and marketplace feedback.
 Analyze sales reports, conversion rates, and product performance.
 Ensure marketplace policies and operational guidelines are followed.
 Identify opportunities for new product launches and business growth.
 Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.
 Required Skills & Qualifications
 Graduate in any discipline (BBA/MBA in Marketing preferred).
 1–3 years of experience in e-commerce sales or marketplace operations preferred.
 Working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Meesho, etc.
 Basic understanding of digital marketing, SEO, and product listing optimization.
 Good knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
 Strong communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
 Target-oriented with analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 Monthly online sales achievement.
 Revenue growth and order volume.
 Product listing quality and visibility.
 Marketplace conversion rate.
 Reduction in order cancellations and returns.
 Inventory availability and order fulfillment.
 Advertising performance and return on ad spend (ROAS).
 Salary & Benefits
 Salary: As per industry standards and candidate experience.
 Performance-based incentives.
 Career growth opportunities.
 Professional and supportive working environment.

unstop-1829261.body:
Aspire Jobs is hiring for the role of Accounts Manager 
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Timings: 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM IST (Monday to Friday)
 Compensation: ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month
 Mode of Work: Work From Office
 Reporting To: Operations Head / Founder
 Industry: U.S. IT Staffing & Recruitment
 About Aspire Jobs 
 Aspire Jobs is a U.S.-focused IT recruitment and staffing firm dedicated to placing international tech professionals in high-growth American IT roles. We specialize in visa-supported placements, including F-1 OPT, STEM OPT, and H-1B pathways, and are committed to providing candidates with reliable career support.
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and responsible Accounts Manager to manage day-to-day accounting activities, maintain accurate financial records, monitor debit and credit transactions, and track monthly collections.
 The candidate will be responsible for maintaining account ledgers, monitoring pending and outstanding invoices, conducting follow-up calls and emails regarding unpaid invoices, reconciling monthly collections, and ensuring accurate financial reporting.
 The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of accounting principles, strong Excel skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage account records and financial data.
 Responsibilities of the Candidate 
 Maintain and update daily accounting records, including debit and credit transactions.
 Monitor the complete flow of incoming and outgoing payments.
 Track pending, outstanding, and overdue invoices and conduct timely follow-up calls and emails.
 Set clear payment expectations with candidates and secure commitment to agreed payment schedules.
 Maintain records of invoices raised, payments received, and outstanding balances.
 Monitor and reconcile monthly collections to ensure all received payments are accurately recorded.
 Prepare monthly collection statements and outstanding payment reports.
 Verify payment entries and identify discrepancies in debit and credit balances.
 Reconcile account statements and ensure that financial records match actual transactions.
 Track monthly revenue, collections, pending payments, and account balances.
 Coordinate with internal departments regarding invoice discrepancies and payment status.
 Maintain proper documentation of invoices, receipts, payment records, and financial statements.
 Identify discrepancies, missing entries, or irregularities in account records and report them to management.
 Ensure accuracy, transparency, and timely updating of all accounting records.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
 Good understanding of basic accounting principles, debit-credit entries, and ledger maintenance.
 Experience in invoice tracking, payment reconciliation, and outstanding account management.
 Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data management, and reporting.
 Experience with Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or other accounting software is preferred.
 Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
 Good communication skills for coordinating and following up on pending invoices.
 Ability to manage financial data accurately and maintain confidentiality.
 Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounting responsibilities.
 What We Offer 
 Competitive salary package of ₹25,000 – ₹35,000 per month.
 Stable full-time night-shift opportunity.
 Career growth within the U.S. staffing and recruitment industry.
 Opportunity to handle financial and accounting operations independently.
 Professional and performance-driven work environment.
 Exposure to international business and financial operations.
 Benefits 
 Paid sick time
 Paid time off

 Bachelor's degree in any discipline (or equivalent experience)

 Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

 Prior experience in COD confirmation calling, NDR management, or e-commerce/logistics support 
 Experience with courier/logistics platforms (Delhivery, Shiprocket, Bluedart, etc.)
 Experience with SaaS, e-commerce, or fintech support 
 Fluency in multiple regional languages

 Competitive salary and performance-based incentives (per confirmed order / resolved NDR)
 Growth opportunities within Customer Support /Operations
 Training on tools and processes

unstop-1829307.body:
Cityfurnish India Private Limited is hiring for Content Creator Intern! 
 Cityfurnish is one of India’s leading furniture and appliance rental platforms, making urban living more affordable, flexible and hassle-free.We’re building the operating system for how urban India furnishes its homes — and we’re looking for creative minds who can help us tell that story in ways people actually want to watch, read and engage with.
 What You’ll Do 
 Copywriting: Write sharp, engaging and persuasive copy for performance ads, social media creatives, campaigns, website communication and other marketing assets.
 Performance Ad Copy: Write hooks, headlines and multiple copy variations for Meta and other digital campaigns with a focus on grabbing attention and driving action.
 Social Media Content: Develop captions, hooks, carousel ideas, topical content and creative concepts for Instagram, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
 Reels & Video Scripts: Ideate and write scripts for Reels, Shorts, UGC-style videos, performance ads and other short-form content.
 Shoot Participation: Work with the team during content shoots and, when required, be comfortable appearing in front of the camera for Reels and social content.
 Research: Understand our audience, competitor communication, internet behaviour and content trends to continuously bring fresh ideas to the table.
 What We’re Looking For 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Strong command of English; good Hindi/Hinglish writing is a big plus.
 Someone who genuinely spends time on social media and understands what people are watching, sharing and talking about right now.
 The ability to write short, sharp and conversational copy instead of generic advertising language.
 An understanding of what makes a strong hook, headline, script or scroll-stopping creative.
 Ability to take a trend and adapt it to a brand instead of simply copying it.
 Creative thinking and the ability to turn simple observations into interesting content ideas.
 Comfortable collaborating with designers, marketers and video creators.
 Comfortable participating in shoots and ideally being in front of the camera when a concept requires it.
 Most importantly, we want someone who takes initiative, brings ideas without waiting to be asked and isn't afraid to experiment.
 Why Join Us? 
 Work in a fast-paced startup environment with plenty of room to experiment creatively.
 Get hands-on experience across social media, performance advertising, content creation and brand building.

amazon-10615176.body:
Role: Buyer
Business area: Procurement Operations
The Procurement Organisation ensures that Amazon gets value for money for non-inventory goods to provide the Fulfilment Centres with the necessary shipping supplies they need to operate smoothly. As a GPCS Buyer, you will provide functional support to all the Fulfilment Centres (FCs) within a cluster of FCs for all aspects of procurement. This includes securing the constant flow of packaging goods and services, supplied at the best overall value to the business on a day to day basis. Responsibilities could also include the compliance check of purchase requisitions, creation of procurement catalogs and onboarding of new vendors.
The number of FCs within a cluster will ideally depend on FC size and other relevant parameters.
• Travel Requirements: Occasional Travel may be required to visit individual FCs within the cluster/other regions (5% of the total time)
Key job responsibilities
The extent of your responsibilities will include but is not limited to:
• Plan and execute the daily forecast and effective materials management of all non-inventory packaging supplies
• Execute purchase order creation
• Liaise with suppliers to secure prompt deliveries
• Develop relationships with primary internal customers (on-site management teams), external suppliers and other Amazon Teams (Operations and Corporate)
• Work in full compliance with the company Spending and Transaction Policy
• Plan truck deliveries in full
• Plan time slots for deliveries upfront with the suppliers
• Communicate the accurate delivery schedule to the local FC materials receiving teams
• Be the escalation POC to ensure deliveries are offloaded as per the agreed timelines with suppliers
• Work with Operations and on site procurement teams to define strategies to mitigate space constraints
• Manage and drive down the number of Invoices on Hold (IOH) requests
• Provide support to other buyers in other regions as and when required
• Provide training to new buyers
• Deliver Procurement metrics in line with set targets. This includes achieving KPI metrics, cost savings for the cluster, no FC stock-out issues and achieving individual project objectives.
• Perform compliance checks on purchase requisitions
• Create, modify or deprecate procurement catalogs
• Perform Vendor Onboarding tasks
- Knowledge of advanced English at CEFR level B2/C1
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with MS Office, in particular MS Excel
- Experience working with Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)
- 1+ years of customer service or back-office roles in corporate environments experience

amazon-10615169.body:
Amazon's Inventory Trust team works to ensure that bad actors cannot profit from using our services to abuse Customers, Selling Partners or our Store. The team works to ensure that illegal inventory within our network is identified and destroyed rather than being returned to the stream of commerce, and to deny our fulfillment network as a means for bad actors to scale their abuse. If we successfully achieve our vision, then Bad Actors will stop committing misconduct on Amazon.
We are looking for an experienced Risk Specialist to own complex investigations, high judgement decisions and escalations associated with our programs. In this role you will work on investigations , manage escalations and communication with external teams to ensure that the Inventory Evaluation team (formerly IDAP) is accurately communicating its decisions to these key stakeholders, and that we are capturing and incorporating feedback related to Seller experience. 
In addition to making the right inventory decisions, the candidate will need to be able to use basic SQL knowledge and use data as evidence to convince/influence key stakeholders.
Key job responsibilities
1. Performs investigation based on high judgement to identify bad actors with unsuitable inventory in Fulfillment Centre.
2. Risk mitigation by continuously giving process improvement, enforcement review, risk mining, queueing improvement etc. ideas.
3. Creates, updates learning modules and support the program in driving improvements to ensure the best customer experience.
4. Identifies & manages small to mid-scale process improvement opportunities at process or team level.
5. Communicates to business leaders on pre-defined guidelines with data and resolves issues with reduced guidance.
6. Work in sync with Program Managers, Risk Managers/Business Analyst and create mechanisms, strategies to achieve the program goals.
7. Tracks and reports progress on key goals specific to the program.
8. Adheres to set targets on productivity and quality.
9. Manages escalations on routine and predefined tasks with minimal supervision.
10. Learns new tools / SOPs / processes with minimal supervision.
11. Effective write up skills and stakeholder management.
- Bachelor's degree
- 18 months of investigations experience as Sr. Investigator, or 12 months experience in bad actor investigations/POE/CDT/Risk mining as Sr. Investigator.
- 6months of experience working with SQL and Advanced Excel.
- Document vetting experience related to supply chain verification is preferred.
- Proven ability to work with upstream teams to fix process gaps is preferred.
- Ability to support business owners in creating detailed investigation summary related to escalations is preferred.

unstop-1827967.body:
Can you tell when an AI tool gets it wrong? 
 This free practice quiz shows you work written by AI, such as a summary, some code or an email, with mistakes in it: a wrong number, a made-up source, an instruction that was ignored, code that breaks on an edge case, or private data handled carelessly. Your job is to find what is wrong. You may keep ChatGPT or any other AI tool open while you answer.
 How it works: 
 10 questions, about 12 minutes. Your score is shown on the spot.
 Free. There are no prizes and no certificates.
 Open to college students, freshers and working professionals.
 What it covers: 
 Following instructions (count, format, audience)
 Facts and sources
 Numbers and units
 Code and edge cases
 Privacy and safe use of data
 Organiser: 
 IAPQB (International AI Practice Qualification Board), a sole proprietorship in the Republic of Korea, publishes free practice sets and open research reports on AI at work. It is not affiliated with any AI company or hiring platform.
 Guide to checking AI output: https://iapqb.org/en/guide/checking-ai-output.html

unstop-1828645.body:
What if you could redesign the digital identity of a national-level youth organization? 
 Welcome to the InteractUp National Hackathon, a multi-round competition where creativity meets technology and ideas transform into real digital experiences. This is your opportunity to build, experiment, innovate and showcase what you can create using technology.
 The Challenge: 
 Explore www.interactup.in and reimagine it.
 Your mission is to redesign, develop and deploy your own version of the InteractUp website, creating an exceptional UI/UX experience that is visually impressive, intuitive, interactive and genuinely useful.
 Think beyond conventional websites. Experiment with immersive experiences, 3D elements, animations, interactive storytelling, creative navigation, innovative features, unique layouts or anything else your imagination can bring to life.
 Your website should be designed keeping multiple audiences in mind, including:
 Students and young professionals
 Colleges and educational institutions
 Companies, brands and potential partners
 Communities, event participants and aspiring entrepreneurs
 Build something that students want to explore, colleges find valuable, companies find interesting and visitors find memorable.
 You are free to use any programming language, framework, development platform, technology, AI tool or workflow. Your creativity and execution are in your hands.
 The existing website is your starting point, not your design limitation. You are free to introduce new sections, experiences, features, layouts and interactions that you believe would make the platform more attractive and effective.
 Make sure to join the following WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/LVXuFXetdjK0S8jAUXOZgh 
 Three Rounds. Multiple Challenges. One Winning Team. 
 This hackathon consists of three project-based rounds. Round 1 begins with the InteractUp website innovation challenge. Participants progressing through the competition will encounter additional project challenges in subsequent rounds.
 Each round is an opportunity to push your creativity further, solve new challenges and demonstrate your ability to build meaningful digital experiences.
 Rewards 
 ₹50,000 Total Cash Prize Pool 
 Top 5 Winners: ₹10,000 each
 Internship Opportunity: Winners will also receive an internship opportunity with InteractUp.
 Exceptional Work Bonus: If a submission demonstrates exceptional creativity, quality and real-world potential, and the website is deemed suitable for actual deployment by InteractUp, the participant may receive an additional ₹50,000 bonus . This is for a website that goes beyond the competition, has the potential to strengthen InteractUp's digital presence, attract brands and partners, and create meaningful opportunities for collaboration.
 What You Must Submit: 
 For Round 1, participants are required to submit:
 Live Website: Link to your deployed, functional website.
 Source Code: Link to your GitHub repository or equivalent or put all relevant folders and files in the drive.
 Walkthrough Video: A video demonstrating your website, its features and overall experience.
 Project Documentation: An explanation of your concept, design decisions, features and development approach.
 Tools & AI Disclosure: Details of the technologies, development tools and AI tools used in a word file.
 All submissions must be compiled into one Word document (.docx) containing the required links and information. Participants must also provide a Google Drive folder containing their walkthrough video and supporting materials.
 Refer to the Round 1 Rules & Guidelines for complete submission instructions.
 Why Participate? 
 Build real projects instead of just presenting ideas.
 Showcase your creativity, technical skills and problem-solving ability.
 Experiment with AI, modern technologies and innovative development approaches.

unstop-1829903.body:
About Us: 
 Arivu Educational Consultants is an Ed-tech company and Academy in Bangalore, established in 2015. It offers tutoring services for a wide variety of professional exams in the commerce stream and has also tied up with various institutions across India to provide integrated courses. Our aim is to be a one-stop solution for all the needs of commerce professionals.
 Qualification: Undergraduate / Post Graduate
 Experience: 1–2 Years
 Job Location: Bengaluru – Koramangala
 Timings: 10 AM – 7 PM
 Language: English, any regional languages
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Mock Test Planning & Execution 
 Plan, schedule, and confirm mock tests for all applicable batches well in advance, ensuring no clashes with the academic calendar.
 Coordinate with faculty and the academic team for timely preparation of question papers, answer keys, and evaluation guidelines.
 Communicate the complete mock test timetable to students ahead of time and confirm the exam mode—online, offline, or hybrid—for every test.
 2. Student Participation & Follow-up 
 Track student attendance for every mock test and maintain a detailed record of those who completed, missed, or partially attempted.
 Follow up daily via calls or messages with absent or irregular students to understand reasons and encourage participation.
 Escalate cases of repeated absenteeism to the academic or support team with proper documentation.
 3. Result Collection & Performance Tracking 
 Collect evaluated answer sheets and marks from faculty promptly and update them accurately in the tracker or ERP within 3 working days.
 Share results with students and parents wherever applicable, ensuring transparency and timely communication.
 Analyze performance data to identify weak students and maintain trend reports to monitor progress over time.
 4. ICU Batch Monitoring 
 Closely monitor ICU batch students on a daily basis, tracking attendance, study discipline, test performance, and overall seriousness.
 Ensure each student follows the designated ICU study plan and coordinate additional academic support for those who are struggling.
 Submit weekly student-wise progress reports to management and flag non-serious students for intervention.
 5. Communication 
 Proactively inform students about upcoming mock schedules, exam rules, results, and post-test feedback sessions well in advance.
 Follow up with parents of low-performing or frequently absent students to keep them informed and involved in the improvement process.
 Maintain professional, clear, and consistent communication across all touchpoints, with zero gaps related to test schedules or results.
 6. Team Coordination 
 Coordinate with faculty for end-to-end test execution, from paper setting and printing to evaluation, feedback sessions, and remedial classes.
 Work with the operations and support team to ensure classrooms, invigilation arrangements, online test links, and all logistics are in place before each mock.
 Liaise with the academic head and management for periodic performance reviews and to stay aligned on priorities.
 7. Data Management & Reporting 
 Maintain fully updated and accurate trackers covering mock schedules, student attendance, marks, performance trends, absentee follow-ups, and parent communication.
 Prepare and submit weekly and monthly reports to management on time, ensuring data accuracy of 95% or above at all times.
 8. Student Improvement 
 Regularly identify students who are consistently scoring low and recommend targeted interventions such as remedial classes, revision sessions, or one-on-one mentoring.
 Create a structured improvement action plan for every weak student and track whether the recommended actions are being completed.
 Ensure every student receives clear and constructive feedback after each mock so they understand their gaps and know what to work on.

4mations Skins is looking for Brand Advocates! 
 About the Campaign: 
 "You've Got Skin in This Game" is a campus movement that turns one known, socially active student per college into the face of 4Mation Skins. Each Brand Advocate is paid a stipend, earns performance perks, and runs real brand activations, so the campus learns the brand from someone it already trusts. 
 Who we are looking for? 
 One student per campus who people already follow and copy. Streams and years are open, but the candidate must be enrolled full-time in the college they represent. 
 Known on campus: recognised by peers for events, clubs, fests,sports,content or hostel life.
 Socially active: runs or joins groups, shows up at events, and has a visible social presence. 
 Trendsetter: starts things people try, from looks and routines to hangout spots.
 Skin in the game: has a stake in the outcome, such as a personal creator page, a club they lead, or a community they own. 
 Reliable: can commit to 4 to 6 weeks of defined activity and show deliverables on time. 
 Draft selection signals, to confirm before launch: Brand Advocate's follower count, past event reach, and a short video pitch on why they should own their campus. 
 Responsibilities of the Intern: 
 The advocate is the brand's campus growth strategist. The mandate covers six outcomes:
 Social and organic growth: Post predefined Reels and Stories in a month, and grow the social media handles.
 Sales growth: Drive sales through a personal code,Meta Ads Strategy/Execution/link(Only If They Want,Not Mandatory)or sampling drop, and run predefined campus activations a month.
 Product visibility: Make each hero SKU, starting with the Dark Spot Reduction Serum and the Beard Combo Kit, a visible part of campus life.
 Brand trust: Collect honest reviews and student testimonials, always disclosed.
 Brand recall: Own one signature campus moment, such as a challenge or a sampling booth.
 Viral campaigns: Run one campus mission a month from the Skin Takeover Game.
 Stipend and Earnings: 
 Every selected Brand Advocate gets a fixed base stipend of 8K/Month once the base KPIs are complete, and can earn upto 75K/month based on the perks & performance incentive on their credibility & value addition towards 4mation Skins in terms of revenue generation & viral campaigns.
 Tenure: 3 Months initially but can be continued as per the performance.

You'll write one adapter per maker, coordinate traffic, lifts and doors through Open-RMF, and make sure every robot status and command is honest. A command is never reported done until the robot confirms it.
 What you'll build 
 Adapters that connect each maker's robot API (REST, WebSocket, MQTT, ROS) to one common robot model.
 Multi-robot coordination on Open-RMF: shared traffic, lift and door queuing, hand-offs and splitting work.
 A command service where every command ends confirmed, refused with a reason, or "don't know".
 An audit log, a clean API for the dashboard team, and simulation tests.
 Must have 
 Strong Python.
 Hands-on ROS 2: nodes, topics, services, launch.
 Has integrated robots or devices through their APIs.
 Has worked with Open-RMF, or can show they learn complex robotics frameworks quickly.
 Writes tests and works with Git and CI.
 Nice to have 
 Mobile-robot or AMR fleet experience.
 VDA 5050 or other MQTT fleet protocols.
 Gazebo simulation.
 Postgres, Docker.
 Building systems such as door and lift controllers.
 Secure software updates.
 How we work 
 Simulation first; open-source tools on free tiers; every result reported as a count out of a stated total, never rounded up or hidden.
 To apply 
 Share a GitHub repo showing ROS 2 or robot API work you wrote yourself. Shortlisted candidates do a short live walkthrough of their code.

Job Title: Web Frontend Engineer Intern (React / Next.js)

Backed by industry veterans who have scaled successful tech companies, we are a fast-moving startup using cutting-edge technology. You won't just be an intern here – you'll ship real code, learn from leaders, and help shape production systems from Day 1. 
 Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Web Frontend Engineer Intern who cares about pixels, polish, and performance. You will work directly with our Lead Engineer to build a high-quality, responsive web application from the ground up. You'll own pages, components, state management, and API integration – all while learning how to ship a production-grade, SEO-friendly web experience using the modern React ecosystem.

 Forms & Validation: React Hook Form, Zod

 Integrate the web application with backend REST APIs for features such as login, product search, and transactions.

 Optimize web performance through image optimization, code splitting, and Core Web Vitals best practices.

 Strong attention to UI/UX details and visual design.

 Receive mentorship from experienced industry professionals.
 Build a portfolio with production-ready work used by real users.
 Opportunity to receive a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance.
 Learn modern technologies including Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and REST APIs.
 Flexible working hours with a remote-first work environment.
 Hybrid work option for candidates in the same locality.
 Work in an asynchronous, documentation-driven culture with minimal meetings.
 Own and contribute to the design and user experience of the web application.
 Work Timings & Mode (We're Flexible!) 
 We understand you may be a student, freelancer, or someone juggling multiple commitments. That's why we offer: 
 Flexible Working Hours – No 9-to-9 grind. Work when you're most productive. Just sync up during core collaboration hours and meet weekly goals. 
 Remote First – Work from home, a café, or a co-working space. As long as you have a stable internet connection, you're good.

7. Carries out tactical issue based communications with internal

unstop-1831742.body:
iSON Xperiences is hiring for Customer Support Executive! 
 About the Company 
 iSON Xperiences operates in the BPO industry and is seeking a Customer Support Executive for its Bangalore team. The role offers an opportunity to support customers through clear, helpful communication and contribute to a positive service experience.
 Responsibilities 
 Respond to customer questions and requests in a professional, courteous manner.
 Communicate effectively in English and Hindi to understand customer needs and explain relevant information.
 Record customer interactions accurately and follow established support processes.
 Coordinate with colleagues to resolve issues and escalate cases when appropriate.
 Maintain service quality while managing customer conversations and follow-up tasks.
 Requirements 
 Applicants may be freshers or have up to three years of relevant experience; candidates with 1–3 years of experience are welcome.
 Strong spoken and written communication skills in English and Hindi.
 A customer-focused approach, patience, and clear problem-solving skills.
 Ability to follow procedures, document interactions, and work collaboratively.
 Based in Bangalore for this in-office, full-time position.
 The annual CTC range for this role is ₹3,00,000 to ₹3,50,000.

unstop-1832132.body:
Aircon India Solutions is hiring a Sales Executive! 
 About the Company: 
 Aircon India Solutions operates in the HVAC industry, serving customers with heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning solutions. The company is seeking an energetic Sales Executive to support customer outreach and sales activity in Geeta Colony, Delhi. This is an opportunity for a fresher to begin a career in sales while learning about HVAC products and customer needs.
 Responsibilities :
 Introduce HVAC products and services to prospective customers and explain their relevant features.
 Build and maintain positive customer relationships through clear, courteous communication.
 Follow up on enquiries, support the sales process, and help customers identify suitable solutions.
 Coordinate with colleagues to share customer feedback and keep sales activity organized.
 Work toward sales objectives and communicate progress to the team.
 Requirements: 
 Suitable for a fresher who is interested in building a career in sales.
 Strong communication, a customer-focused attitude, and willingness to learn about HVAC solutions.
 Professional and confident interaction with prospective customers.
 Ability to work in person in Geeta Colony, Delhi, and contribute to a full-time sales role.
 The annual salary is ₹3,00,000, with incentives offered in addition to the salary.

Smart SEO Tech is hiring for an SMO Executive! 
 About the Company:

 Responsibilities:

unstop-1831252.body:
Who We Are: 
Ubicue Marketing helps ambitious brands grow through the combination of strategy, creativity, media, technology, and data.
 The Role: 
We’re looking for a Digital Marketing Project Coordinator to help our team take client work from the initial brief through to launch and handover. You’ll coordinate individual projects and keep track of how they fit into each client’s broader marketing program.
Our specialists handle campaign setup, technical SEO, web development and creative production. Your responsibility is to understand what each person needs, put the work in the right order and follow through until it’s delivered.
 What You’ll Own: 
 Project planning: Turn briefs into practical plans with clear deliverables, owners, deadlines and approvals. Work with specialists to understand effort and dependencies before confirming dates.
 Program coordination: Maintain a shared calendar across campaigns, content and website projects. Spot competing deadlines or missing inputs early and flag what needs a decision.
 Technical and creative handoffs: Coordinate briefs, assets and feedback across teams. For a campaign launch, that could mean getting creative approved, confirming the landing page is ready and checking with analytics that conversion tracking has been tested.
 Client and team meetings: Prepare agendas around decisions needed, capture what was agreed and follow up with each owner before the next meeting.
 Closing the loop: Check the work against the brief, confirm specialist reviews and client approvals, and verify that the final deliverable went live or reached the client. Let everyone involved know what’s complete and who owns any next steps.
 What We’re Looking For 
 1–3 years of experience coordinating digital marketing projects, campaigns or client deliverables, ideally in an agency.
 A working understanding of how paid media, SEO, websites, analytics, social content and creative production fit together.
 Clear written and spoken English, sound judgment about when to raise an issue, and the ability to keep several projects moving.
 Bonus Points: 
Hands-on experience in any one of these areas: paid campaigns, SEO, WordPress or landing pages, analytics and reporting, or content and video production. Familiarity with project tools such as Asana or ClickUp, or using AI and automation to simplify recurring work, is also valuable.
 What Sets You Apart: 
When a client says, “Let’s launch Friday,” you know what to ask: What still needs approval? Who’s testing the form? Who will confirm we’re live? Then you follow through on the answers.
 Why This Role Matters: 
You’ll help a small team deliver reliably and give clients a clear picture of where their work stands. It’s a practical next step for someone who wants to grow into a Digital Marketing Project Manager.
Benefits: Flexible schedule, paid sick time, paid time off and work from home.

amazon-10604058.body:
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion. 
Key job responsibilities
• Act as the primary point of contact between Amazon's internal teams and North America (NA) business customers to validate and confirm accurate address and location details.
• Apply a strong eye for detail to research, verify, and update correct address and geo-coordinate information in Geo Studio.
• Process a high volume of Address ID's within defined time windows while consistently maintaining a quality bar of 98% or higher.
• Communicate fluently and confidently in English (verbal and written) when speaking with NA business customers to resolve address discrepancies.
• Identify patterns in flagged Address ID's (e.g., incorrect pins, missing business hours, vacant locations) and escalate data gaps to the relevant teams.
• Use internal tools (Geo Studio, SIM, Connect) to research, validate, and correct address and location data.
• Track personal productivity and quality metrics daily; consistently meet Address ID handling volume and accuracy targets.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to reduce recurring address errors and improve overall data quality.
• 
- • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
- • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; comfortable speaking directly with North America based business customers.
- • Strong attention to detail with the ability to research and validate data accurately.
- • Working knowledge of Excel and basic data analysis tools.
- • Ability to work in a fast-paced, metric-driven, 24/7 shift-based environment.
- • Familiarity with Geo Studio, SIM, or similar Amazon internal tools.
- • Experience working directly with external or business customers over phone or email.
- • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP) and exposure to QuickSight.

Not only are we a one-stop hub for distinctive, critically-acclaimed and award-winning original programming including TV series such as Fallout, Reacher, TheLord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, Citadel, and Spider-Noir, and record-breaking new launches like Off Campus, Cross, and The Boys, and movies like Tom Clancy’s Jack Ryan: Ghost War, Pretty Lethal, The Wrecking Crew, and Drawn Together, but we offer a multi-dimensional experience that allows subscribers to fully immerse themselves in their fandom: to read the book, to listen to the soundtrack, to buy the costume, to replay live sports in real time, and more. And that breadth and connection to the Amazon family of brands, along with thesupport of a passionate and diverse global team, makes Prime Video a company where creators and makers of all kinds can build their future.
The Global Shared Services (GSS) at Prime Video is an operationally-driven team of designers, producers, QA specialists and operations managers responsible for creating and delivering high volumes of digital assets. GPS is seeking a Visual Designer with the ability to deliver clean, digital-ready designs based on existing style guides and brand guidelines in a fast-paced production environment. This position requires strong intrinsic design ability, typographic skills, acute attention to detail, and web expertise. The ability to manage multiple projects and large volume is essential.
Key job responsibilities
The candidate will have a comprehensive understanding of graphic design processes and software, specifically for graphic production, along with experience and a successful track record in digital marketing at fast-paced environments. Additionally, this candidate should have a keen eye for detail, and an excellent ability to communicate.
• Create on-brand digital design solutions that meet business goals and project requirements.
• Create best in class layouts and visuals that support and reinforce business objectives while partnering with business/marketing teams to ensure that designs meet brand and business needs.
• Present work to team and key stakeholders for review, feedback, and approval.
• Ensure design requirements are met in adherence with product/project guidelines.
• Optimize digital images for web, mobile, big screen and other devices.
• Follow and apply graphic templates and style guides.
• Help ensure quality control, while working closely with marketing stakeholders, design peers and quality specialist.
• Fulfill multiple projects requests while simultaneously meeting tight deadlines.
• Illustrate a command of design methods, tools, communication, and presentation skills.
- Knowledge of Adobe design programs including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite
